280	/**
281	 * The abstract `llm` service: an adapter registry plus a streaming model-call
282	 * API, interceptable via the `llm/stream` waterfall.
283	 */
284	export class LlmRuntime extends Service {
285	  private adapters = new Map<string, AdapterRegistration>()
286	  private directory = new Map<string, LlmConfigurableProvider>()
287	  private discoveries = new Map<
288	    string,
289	    (request: LlmModelDiscoveryRequest) => Promise<readonly LlmDiscoveredModel[]>
290	  >()
291	
292	  constructor(ctx: Context) {
293	    super(ctx, 'llm')
294	  }
295	
296	  /** Notify topology observers without letting one broken listener veto the commit. */
297	  private emitAdaptersUpdated(): void {
298	    // Cordis emit uses Array.map: one synchronous throw starves later
299	    // listeners. Registry notifications are non-vetoing, so contain each
300	    // callback independently; INVARIANT-coded failures still surface.
301	    let invariantFailure: unknown
302	    for (const listener of this.ctx.events.dispatch('emit', ['llm/adapters-updated']) as Array<() => unknown>) {
303	      try {
304	        const returned = listener()
305	        if (returned != null && typeof (returned as PromiseLike<unknown>).then === 'function') {
306	          // An emit listener may still be an async function; its rejection
307	          // cannot reach the synchronous INVARIANT rethrow below, so it is
308	          // contained here instead of becoming an unhandled rejection.
309	          void Promise.resolve(returned as PromiseLike<unknown>).then(undefined, (error: unknown) => {
310	            this.warnAdaptersListenerFailure(error)
311	          })
312	        }
313	      } catch (error) {
314	        if ((error as { code?: unknown } | null)?.code === 'INVARIANT') {
315	          invariantFailure ??= error
316	          continue
317	        }
318	        this.warnAdaptersListenerFailure(error)
319	      }
320	    }
321	    if (invariantFailure !== undefined) throw invariantFailure as Error
322	  }
323	
324	  /** Contained-listener diagnostic shared by the sync and async failure paths. */
325	  private warnAdaptersListenerFailure(error: unknown): void {
326	    this.ctx.logger.warn('llm: an llm/adapters-updated listener failed')
327	    this.ctx.logger.warn(error)
328	  }
329	
330	  /**
331	   * Register an adapter for the given provider routes. Throws `LlmError` with code
332	   * `DUPLICATE_ADAPTER` if any provider already has an adapter (all-or-nothing).
333	   * Disposed with the fiber.
334	   * @param providers - every provider route this adapter should serve.
335	   * @param adapter - the adapter that streams calls for those providers.
336	   * @returns the disposer, carrying {@link AdapterRegistrationHandle.replace}.
337	   */
338	  registerAdapter(providers: string[], adapter: LlmAdapter): AdapterRegistrationHandle {
339	    // The routes this registration currently holds; `replace` rewrites it, and
340	    // the disposer releases whatever it holds at disposal time.
341	    const owned = new Set<string>()
342	    // The disposer has run: `owned` being empty cannot say so on its own,
343	    // because `replace([])` legally leaves a live registration holding none.
344	    let released = false
345	    const dispose = this.ctx.effect(function* (this: LlmRuntime) {
346	      if (providers.length === 0) throw new LlmError('an adapter must register at least one provider', 'INVALID_ADAPTER')
347	      this.commitRoutes(owned, this.prepareRoutes(providers, adapter, owned))
348	      yield () => {
349	        released = true
350	        for (const provider of owned) this.adapters.delete(provider)
351	        owned.clear()
352	        this.emitAdaptersUpdated()
353	      }
354	    }.bind(this), 'llm.registerAdapter()')
355	    // ctx.effect's disposer returns Promise<void>; our disposer API is
356	    // synchronous fire-and-forget — discard the (always-resolved) promise.
357	    const handle = (() => void dispose()) as AdapterRegistrationHandle
358	    handle.replace = (next: string[]): void => {
359	      // Registering here would leak: the effect's disposer already ran, so
360	      // nothing remains to release whatever this call would put in the map.
361	      if (released) {
362	        throw new LlmError('a disposed adapter registration cannot replace its routes', 'REGISTRATION_DISPOSED')
363	      }
364	      this.commitRoutes(owned, this.prepareRoutes(next, adapter, owned))
365	    }
366	    return handle
367	  }
368	
369	  /**
370	   * Validate one candidate route set for `adapter`, treating routes this
371	   * registration already holds as available. Nothing is mutated: a rejected
372	   * candidate leaves the registry exactly as it was.
373	   */
374	  private prepareRoutes(providers: string[], adapter: LlmAdapter, owned: ReadonlySet<string>): AdapterRegistration[] {
375	    const unique = new Set<string>()
376	    const registrations: AdapterRegistration[] = []
377	    for (const provider of providers) {
378	      if (provider.length === 0) throw new LlmError('adapter provider names must be non-empty', 'INVALID_ADAPTER')
379	      if (unique.has(provider) || (this.adapters.has(provider) && !owned.has(provider))) {
380	        throw new LlmError(`an adapter for provider "${provider}" is already registered`, 'DUPLICATE_ADAPTER')
381	      }
382	      const info = adapter.providerInfo(provider)
383	      if (typeof info.id !== 'string' || info.id !== provider || typeof info.name !== 'string' || info.name.length === 0) {
384	        throw new LlmError(`adapter metadata for provider "${provider}" must preserve its id and have a non-empty name`, 'INVALID_ADAPTER')
385	      }
386	      unique.add(provider)
387	      const retryPolicy = adapter.providerRetryPolicy(provider)
388	        ?? resolveRetryPolicy(undefined, `llm: provider "${provider}" retryPolicy`)
389	      registrations.push({
390	        adapter,
391	        provider: { id: info.id, name: info.name },
392	        retryPolicy,
393	      })
394	    }
395	    return registrations
396	  }
397	
398	  /**
399	   * Swap this registration's routes for the prepared ones in one synchronous
400	   * section, so no observer can see the registry between the release and the
401	   * re-registration. The route set's one mutation point is also where
402	   * `llm/adapters-updated` is published, so a `replace` announces itself
403	   * exactly like a first registration.
404	   */
405	  private commitRoutes(owned: Set<string>, registrations: readonly AdapterRegistration[]): void {
406	    for (const provider of owned) this.adapters.delete(provider)
407	    owned.clear()
408	    for (const registration of registrations) {
409	      this.adapters.set(registration.provider.id, registration)
410	      owned.add(registration.provider.id)
411	    }
412	    this.emitAdaptersUpdated()
413	  }
414	
415	  /**
416	   * Describe provider routes with a registered adapter.
417	   * @returns detached provider metadata in registration order.
418	   */
419	  listProviders(): LlmProviderInfo[] {
420	    return [...this.adapters.values()].map(({ provider }) => ({ ...provider }))
421	  }
422	
423	  /**
424	   * Declare provider routes an adapter plugin can activate through
425	   * configuration. Registration is all-or-nothing: an empty list, invalid
426	   * entry, or a provider already declared by any registration throws
427	   * `LlmError` without registering the rest. Disposed with the fiber.
428	   * @param entries - every configurable provider this plugin owns.
429	   * @returns a handle that withdraws all of them, and can atomically replace them.
430	   */
431	  registerConfigurableProviders(entries: readonly LlmConfigurableProvider[]): DirectoryRegistrationHandle {
432	    let held: LlmConfigurableProvider[] = []
433	    let disposed = false
434	    /**
435	     * Validate a candidate set in full against everything this registration
436	     * does not already hold, then publish it. Nothing is written until the
437	     * whole set passes, so a refused candidate leaves the current entries in
438	     * place — the property that makes `replace` a swap rather than a
439	     * delete-then-add that can strand the directory empty.
440	     */
441	    const commit = (candidates: readonly LlmConfigurableProvider[]): void => {
442	      const detached: LlmConfigurableProvider[] = []
443	      const own = new Set(held.map(entry => entry.provider))
444	      for (const entry of candidates) {
445	        if (entry.provider.length === 0 || entry.displayName.length === 0 || entry.settingsNs.length === 0) {
446	          throw new LlmError('configurable providers need a non-empty provider, displayName, and settingsNs', 'INVALID_DIRECTORY')
447	        }
448	        if (entry.settingsPath.some(segment => segment.length === 0)) {
449	          throw new LlmError(`configurable provider "${entry.provider}" has an empty settingsPath segment`, 'INVALID_DIRECTORY')
450	        }
451	        if ((this.directory.has(entry.provider) && !own.has(entry.provider))
452	          || detached.some(seen => seen.provider === entry.provider)) {
453	          throw new LlmError(`configurable provider "${entry.provider}" is already declared`, 'DUPLICATE_DIRECTORY')
454	        }
455	        detached.push({ ...entry, settingsPath: [...entry.settingsPath] })
456	      }
457	      for (const entry of held) this.directory.delete(entry.provider)
458	      for (const entry of detached) this.directory.set(entry.provider, entry)
459	      held = detached
460	      this.emitAdaptersUpdated()
461	    }
462	
463	    const dispose = this.ctx.effect(function* (this: LlmRuntime) {
464	      if (entries.length === 0) {
465	        throw new LlmError('a configurable-provider registration must declare at least one provider', 'INVALID_DIRECTORY')
466	      }
467	      commit(entries)
468	      yield () => {
469	        disposed = true
470	        for (const entry of held) this.directory.delete(entry.provider)
471	        held = []
472	        this.emitAdaptersUpdated()
473	      }
474	    }.bind(this), 'llm.registerConfigurableProviders()')
475	
476	    const handle = ((): void => void dispose()) as DirectoryRegistrationHandle
477	    handle.replace = (next: readonly LlmConfigurableProvider[]): void => {
478	      if (disposed) {
479	        throw new LlmError('this configurable-provider registration was disposed', 'REGISTRATION_DISPOSED')
480	      }
481	      commit(next)
482	    }
483	    return handle
484	  }
485	
486	  /**
487	   * List every declared configurable provider, registered or dormant.
488	   * @returns detached directory entries in declaration order.
489	   */
490	  listConfigurableProviders(): LlmConfigurableProvider[] {
491	    return [...this.directory.values()].map(entry => ({ ...entry, settingsPath: [...entry.settingsPath] }))
492	  }
493	
494	  /**
495	   * Offer to interrogate provider endpoints on behalf of the settings
496	   * namespace this plugin owns. The namespace is the key because that is what
497	   * a configuration surface already holds from the configurable-provider
498	   * directory, and because a provider being *added* has no route to name yet.
499	   * Disposed with the fiber.
500	   * @param settingsNs - the namespace whose profiles this discovery serves.
501	   * @param discover - interrogates one endpoint; must honor `request.signal`.
502	   * @returns the disposer that withdraws the offer.
503	   */
504	  registerModelDiscovery(
505	    settingsNs: string,
506	    discover: (request: LlmModelDiscoveryRequest) => Promise<readonly LlmDiscoveredModel[]>,
507	  ): () => void {
508	    const dispose = this.ctx.effect(function* (this: LlmRuntime) {
509	      if (settingsNs.length === 0) {
510	        throw new LlmError('model discovery needs a non-empty settings namespace', 'INVALID_DISCOVERY')
511	      }
512	      if (this.discoveries.has(settingsNs)) {
513	        throw new LlmError(`model discovery for "${settingsNs}" is already registered`, 'DUPLICATE_DISCOVERY')
514	      }
515	      this.discoveries.set(settingsNs, discover)
516	      yield () => {
517	        this.discoveries.delete(settingsNs)
518	      }
519	    }.bind(this), 'llm.registerModelDiscovery()')
520	    return () => void dispose()
521	  }

523	  /**
524	   * Interrogate one provider endpoint for the models it advertises. The
525	   * request describes a draft, not a stored route, so nothing here reads or
526	   * writes settings or credentials — the caller owns both, and the reply is
527	   * candidate metadata a surface may offer for adoption.
528	   * @param settingsNs - namespace whose registered discovery serves this draft.
529	   * @param request - the endpoint, protocol, and one-shot credential to use.
530	   * @returns the advertised models, deduplicated in endpoint order.
531	   */
532	  async discoverModels(
533	    settingsNs: string,
534	    request: LlmModelDiscoveryRequest,
535	  ): Promise<LlmDiscoveredModel[]> {
536	    const discover = this.discoveries.get(settingsNs)
537	    if (discover === undefined) {
538	      throw new LlmError(`no model discovery is registered for "${settingsNs}"`, 'NO_DISCOVERY')
539	    }
540	    // One of the two identifies what to describe: a route the adapter knows, or
541	    // an endpoint to ask. Neither leaves nothing to answer about.
542	    if ((request.provider ?? '').length === 0 && (request.baseURL ?? '').length === 0) {
543	      throw new LlmError('model discovery needs a provider route or a baseURL', 'INVALID_DISCOVERY')
544	    }
545	    const discovered = await discover(request)
546	    const seen = new Set<string>()
547	    const models: LlmDiscoveredModel[] = []
548	    for (const model of discovered) {
549	      if (typeof model.id !== 'string' || model.id.length === 0 || seen.has(model.id)) continue
550	      seen.add(model.id)
551	      models.push({
552	        id: model.id,
553	        ...model.name === undefined ? {} : { name: model.name },
554	        ...model.contextWindow === undefined ? {} : { contextWindow: model.contextWindow },
555	        ...model.maxTokens === undefined ? {} : { maxTokens: model.maxTokens },
556	      })
557	    }
558	    return models
559	  }

572	    return modalities === undefined ? undefined : [...modalities]

575	  /**
576	   * Discover models advertised by one registered provider. Catalog membership
577	   * is advisory and never changes routing or request validation.
578	   * @param provider - registered provider route to inspect.
579	   * @returns detached model metadata in adapter-preferred order.
580	   */
581	  async listModels(provider: string): Promise<LlmModelInfo[]> {
582	    const adapter = this.registration(provider).adapter
583	    const models = await adapter.listModels(provider)
584	    const seen = new Set<string>()
585	    return models.map((model) => {
586	      if (
587	        typeof model.provider !== 'string'
588	        || model.provider !== provider
589	        || typeof model.id !== 'string'
590	        || model.id.length === 0
591	        || typeof model.name !== 'string'
592	        || model.name.length === 0
593	        || (model.description !== undefined && typeof model.description !== 'string')
594	        || seen.has(model.id)
595	      ) {
596	        throw new LlmError(`adapter returned invalid or duplicate model metadata for provider "${provider}"`, 'INVALID_CATALOG')
597	      }
598	      seen.add(model.id)
599	      const inputModalities = this.detachedModalities(model.inputModalities)
600	      return {
601	        provider: model.provider,
602	        id: model.id,
603	        name: model.name,
604	        ...model.description === undefined ? {} : { description: model.description },
605	        ...inputModalities === undefined ? {} : { inputModalities },
606	      }

610	  /**
611	   * Resolve and validate all metadata from the adapter that owns one exact
612	   * route. The result is detached from adapter-owned objects; catalog
613	   * membership remains advisory and does not control request routing.
614	   * @param provider - registered provider route to inspect.
615	   * @param model - exact model id passed to the adapter.
616	   * @param signal - optional cancellation for adapter-owned asynchronous lookup.
617	   * @returns exact model identity plus available context and reasoning metadata.
618	   */
619	  async resolveModelInfo(
620	    provider: string,
621	    model: string,
622	    signal?: AbortSignal,
623	  ): Promise<LlmResolvedModelInfo> {
624	    return this.resolveModelInfoFor(this.registration(provider), model, signal)
625	  }

627	  private async resolveModelInfoFor(
628	    registration: AdapterRegistration,
629	    model: string,
630	    signal?: AbortSignal,
631	  ): Promise<LlmResolvedModelInfo> {
632	    const provider = registration.provider.id
633	    const resolved = await registration.adapter.resolveModel(provider, model, signal)
634	    if (
635	      typeof resolved.provider !== 'string'
636	      || resolved.provider !== provider
637	      || typeof resolved.id !== 'string'
638	      || resolved.id !== model
639	      || typeof resolved.name !== 'string'
640	      || resolved.name.length === 0
641	      || (resolved.description !== undefined && typeof resolved.description !== 'string')
642	    ) {
643	      throw new LlmError(
644	        `adapter returned invalid exact model metadata for provider "${provider}" model "${model}"`,
645	        'INVALID_MODEL_INFO',
646	      )
647	    }
648	    const context = resolved.context
649	    if (context !== undefined && (!Number.isInteger(context.contextWindow) || context.contextWindow <= 0)) {
650	      throw new LlmError(
651	        `adapter returned invalid context metadata for provider "${provider}" model "${model}"`,
652	        'INVALID_MODEL_CONTEXT',
653	      )
654	    }
655	    // Capability metadata rides through: an explicit modality omission is
656	    // negative capability downstream preflights act on (image admission).
657	    const inputModalities = this.detachedModalities(resolved.inputModalities)
658	    const defaultMaxTokens = resolved.defaultMaxTokens
659	    if (defaultMaxTokens !== undefined
660	      && (!Number.isSafeInteger(defaultMaxTokens) || defaultMaxTokens <= 0)) {
661	      throw new LlmError(
662	        `adapter returned invalid default maxTokens for provider "${provider}" model "${model}"`,
663	        'INVALID_MODEL_MAX_TOKENS',
664	      )
665	    }
666	    const info: LlmResolvedModelInfo = {
667	      provider,
668	      id: model,
669	      name: resolved.name,
670	      ...resolved.description === undefined ? {} : { description: resolved.description },
671	      ...inputModalities === undefined ? {} : { inputModalities },
672	      ...context === undefined ? {} : { context: { contextWindow: context.contextWindow } },
673	      ...defaultMaxTokens === undefined ? {} : { defaultMaxTokens },
674	    }
675	    const reasoning = resolved.reasoning
676	    if (reasoning === undefined) return info
677	    if (reasoning.efforts.length === 0) {
678	      throw new LlmError(
679	        `adapter returned invalid reasoning metadata for provider "${provider}" model "${model}"`,
680	        'INVALID_MODEL_REASONING',
681	      )
682	    }
683	    const seen = new Set<string>()
684	    const efforts = reasoning.efforts.map((effort) => {
685	      if (
686	        typeof effort.id !== 'string'
687	        || effort.id.length === 0
688	        || typeof effort.name !== 'string'
689	        || effort.name.length === 0
690	        || (effort.description !== undefined && typeof effort.description !== 'string')
691	        || seen.has(effort.id)
692	      ) {
693	        throw new LlmError(
694	          `adapter returned invalid or duplicate reasoning effort metadata for provider "${provider}" model "${model}"`,
695	          'INVALID_MODEL_REASONING',
696	        )
697	      }
698	      seen.add(effort.id)
699	      return {
700	        id: effort.id,
701	        name: effort.name,
702	        ...effort.description === undefined ? {} : { description: effort.description },
703	      }
704	    })
705	    if (reasoning.defaultEffort !== undefined && !seen.has(reasoning.defaultEffort)) {
706	      throw new LlmError(
707	        `adapter returned an unknown default reasoning effort for provider "${provider}" model "${model}"`,
708	        'INVALID_MODEL_REASONING',
709	      )
710	    }
711	    return {
712	      ...info,
713	      reasoning: {
714	        efforts,
715	        ...reasoning.defaultEffort === undefined ? {} : { defaultEffort: reasoning.defaultEffort },
716	      },
717	    }
718	  }

720	  /**
721	   * Validate a conversation call config against its exact model capability and
722	   * materialize adapter-configured defaults. Unsupported explicit efforts
723	   * reject before provider I/O; no clamping or aliasing is performed. This
724	   * standalone query does not bind a later dispatch; use {@link prepareCall}
725	   * when logging and streaming must share one adapter registration.
726	   * @param config - provider/model route and optional request controls.
727	   * @param signal - optional cancellation for adapter-owned capability lookup.
728	   * @returns a detached config only when a default must be materialized.
729	   */
730	  async resolveCallConfig(config: LlmCallConfig, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<LlmCallConfig> {
731	    return (await this.resolveCallFor(this.registration(config.provider), config, signal)).config
732	  }
733	
734	  private async resolveCallFor(
735	    registration: AdapterRegistration,
736	    config: LlmCallConfig,
737	    signal?: AbortSignal,
738	  ): Promise<{ config: LlmCallConfig; context?: LlmModelContext }> {
739	    const info = await this.resolveModelInfoFor(registration, config.model, signal)
740	    const defaulted = config.maxTokens === undefined && info.defaultMaxTokens !== undefined
741	      ? { ...config, maxTokens: info.defaultMaxTokens }
742	      : config
743	    const reasoning = info.reasoning
744	    const requested = defaulted.reasoningEffort
745	    let resolvedConfig = defaulted
746	    if (reasoning === undefined) {
747	      if (requested !== undefined) {
748	        throw new LlmError(
749	          `provider "${config.provider}" model "${config.model}" does not support reasoning effort "${requested}"`,
750	          'UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT',
751	        )
752	      }
753	    } else {
754	      const effective = requested ?? reasoning.defaultEffort
755	      if (effective !== undefined) {
756	        if (!reasoning.efforts.some(effort => effort.id === effective)) {
757	          throw new LlmError(
758	            `provider "${config.provider}" model "${config.model}" does not support reasoning effort "${effective}"`,
759	            'UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT',
760	          )
761	        }
762	        if (requested !== effective) resolvedConfig = { ...defaulted, reasoningEffort: effective }
763	      }
764	    }
765	    return {
766	      config: resolvedConfig,
767	      ...info.context === undefined ? {} : { context: info.context },
768	    }
769	  }

771	  /**
772	   * Resolve one call under its current adapter registration. The returned
773	   * one-shot handle keeps that registration across header logging and dispatch,
774	   * so HMR cannot combine one adapter's capability result with another adapter.
775	   * @param config - provider/model route and optional request controls.
776	   * @param signal - optional cancellation for adapter-owned capability lookup.
777	   * @returns a prepared config and its registration-bound stream entry point.
778	   */
779	  async prepareCall(config: LlmCallConfig, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<PreparedLlmCall> {
780	    const registration = this.registration(config.provider)
781	    const resolved = await this.resolveCallFor(registration, config, signal)
782	    const resolvedConfig = deepFreeze(structuredClone(resolved.config))
783	    const context = resolved.context === undefined
784	      ? undefined
785	      : deepFreeze(structuredClone(resolved.context))
786	    const adapterDefaults = deepFreeze<LlmCallConfigAdapterDefaults>({
787	      ...config.reasoningEffort === undefined && resolvedConfig.reasoningEffort !== undefined
788	        ? { reasoningEffort: true }
789	        : {},
790	      ...config.maxTokens === undefined && resolvedConfig.maxTokens !== undefined
791	        ? { maxTokens: true }
792	        : {},
793	    })
794	    let dispatched = false
795	    return Object.freeze({
796	      config: resolvedConfig,
797	      retryPolicy: registration.retryPolicy,
798	      adapterDefaults,
799	      ...context === undefined ? {} : { context },
800	      stream: (options: GenerateOptions): AsyncIterable<StreamChunk> => {
801	        if (dispatched) {
802	          throw new LlmError('a prepared LLM call can only be dispatched once', 'INVALID_PREPARED_CALL')
803	        }
804	        if (!callConfigEquals(options, resolvedConfig)) {
805	          throw new LlmError(
806	            'prepared LLM call config changed before adapter dispatch',
807	            'INVALID_PREPARED_CALL',
808	          )
809	        }
810	        dispatched = true
811	        return this.streamWithRegistration(options, { registration, config: resolvedConfig })
812	      },
813	    })
814	  }

816	  private registration(provider: string): AdapterRegistration {
817	    const registration = this.adapters.get(provider)
818	    if (!registration) throw new LlmError(`no adapter registered for provider "${provider}"`, 'NO_ADAPTER')
819	    return registration
820	  }

822	  /** Remove replay state whose historical route is owned by another adapter. */
823	  private forAdapter(options: GenerateOptions, adapter: LlmAdapter): GenerateOptions {
824	    const messages: Message[] = options.messages.map((message) => {
825	      const source = message.source
826	      if (message.role !== 'assistant' || source.kind !== 'model' || source.replayState === undefined) return message
827	      if (this.adapters.get(source.provider)?.adapter === adapter) return message
828	      return freezeMessage({
829	        ...message,
830	        source: { kind: 'model', provider: source.provider, model: source.model },
831	      })
832	    })
833	    if (messages.every((message, index) => message === options.messages[index])) return options
834	    const filtered = { ...options, messages }
835	    return Object.isFrozen(options) ? deepFreeze(filtered) : filtered
836	  }

838	  /**
839	   * Final adapter boundary. Adapter selection, dispatch, iterator construction,
840	   * and iteration failures become one terminal failure chunk. Middleware and
841	   * downstream consumer failures remain thrown plugin or consumer errors.
842	   */
843	  private async * adapterStream(
844	    options: GenerateOptions,
845	    prepared?: { registration: AdapterRegistration; config: LlmCallConfig },
846	  ): AsyncGenerator<StreamChunk> {
847	    let iterator: AsyncIterator<StreamChunk>
848	    try {
849	      const registration = prepared?.registration ?? this.registration(options.provider)
850	      const resolvedConfig = prepared === undefined
851	        ? (await this.resolveCallFor(registration, options, options.signal)).config
852	        : prepared.config
853	      if (prepared !== undefined && !callConfigEquals(options, resolvedConfig)) {
854	        throw new LlmError(
855	          'prepared LLM call config changed before adapter dispatch',
856	          'INVALID_PREPARED_CALL',
857	        )
858	      }
859	      const resolvedOptions = callConfigEquals(options, resolvedConfig)
860	        ? options
861	        : Object.isFrozen(options)
862	          ? deepFreeze({ ...options, ...resolvedConfig })
863	          : { ...options, ...resolvedConfig }
864	      const adapter = registration.adapter
865	      const stream = adapter.stream(this.forAdapter(resolvedOptions, adapter))
866	      iterator = stream[Symbol.asyncIterator]()
867	    } catch (error: unknown) {
868	      yield adapterFailureChunk(error, options.signal)
869	      return
870	    }
871	
872	    let completed = false
873	    try {
874	      while (true) {
875	        let item: { done: true } | { done: false; value: StreamChunk }
876	        try {
877	          const next = await iterator.next()
878	          item = next.done
879	            ? { done: true }
880	            : { done: false, value: next.value }
881	        } catch (error: unknown) {
882	          completed = true
883	          yield adapterFailureChunk(error, options.signal)
884	          return
885	        }
886	        if (item.done) {
887	          completed = true
888	          return
889	        }
890	        // End the adapter-owned try before yielding: consumer/middleware
891	        // failures resumed into this generator must remain thrown.
892	        yield item.value
893	      }
894	    } finally {
895	      if (!completed) {
896	        const close = iterator.return?.bind(iterator)
897	        if (close) await close()
898	      }
899	    }
900	  }

902	  /**
903	   * Stream one model call as raw chunks (token-level deltas). Replay state is
904	   * retained only when the same adapter instance owns its historical provider
905	   * and the target provider. Final adapter selection remains fixed through
906	   * asynchronous exact-model resolution and dispatch. Adapter selection,
907	   * dispatch, and iteration failures become terminal `error` or `aborted`
908	   * finish chunks; middleware, nested-call, cleanup, and consumer failures
909	   * remain thrown.
910	   * @param options - the full request; `options.provider` selects the adapter.
911	   * @returns the chunk stream, possibly wrapped by `llm/stream` listeners.
912	   */
913	  stream(options: GenerateOptions): AsyncIterable<StreamChunk> {
914	    return this.streamWithRegistration(options)
915	  }
916	
917	  private streamWithRegistration(
918	    options: GenerateOptions,
919	    prepared?: { registration: AdapterRegistration; config: LlmCallConfig },
920	  ): AsyncIterable<StreamChunk> {
921	    return this.ctx.waterfall(
922	      this,
923	      'llm/stream',
924	      options,
925	      () => this.adapterStream(options, prepared),
926	    )
927	  }
928	}

930	/** Convert one adapter throw into the stream protocol's terminal outcome. */
931	function adapterFailureChunk(error: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal): StreamChunk {
932	  const failure = normalizeLlmFailure(error)
933	  return {
934	    type: 'finish',
935	    reason: signal?.aborted || failure.code === 'ABORTED'
936	      ? { kind: 'aborted', failure }
937	      : { kind: 'error', failure },
938	  }
939	}

32	/**
33	 * The kind of information in producer-supplied context, declared by the
34	 * producer beside its provenance.
35	 *
36	 * `MessageSource.kind` answers *who produced this*; `form` answers *what kind
37	 * of thing it is*, and the two axes are deliberately independent — several
38	 * producers share one form, and one producer may emit more than one form over
39	 * a session.
40	 *
41	 * The vocabulary is SEMANTIC, never visual: a value states that the content is
42	 * a file's instructions or a catalog of available items, and a consumer decides
43	 * what that looks like. Colors, icons, ordering, and collapse defaults are the
44	 * consumer's business and must not enter this union. It grows one value at a
45	 * time as producers gain the structured fields their form needs; an absent or
46	 * unknown value is the documented default, presented as opaque content.
47	 */
48	export type ContextForm =
49	  /** Instructions read out of workspace files the model is expected to follow. */
50	  | 'instructions'
51	  /** A catalog of items available in this session, republished as it changes. */
52	  | 'catalog'
53	  /** Current state, where a later snapshot from the same producer supersedes an earlier one. */
54	  | 'snapshot'
55	  /** A one-off account of something that just happened; it supersedes nothing. */
56	  | 'notice'
57	  /** A message another agent addressed to this one. */
58	  | 'relay'
59	  /** Material lifted out of another session's log, possibly reduced on the way in. */
60	  | 'recall'

62	/** One named contribution to a `snapshot`-form context, in assembly order. */
63	export interface ContextSnapshotSection {
64	  /** The contributing subsystem's name. */
65	  readonly name: string

67	  readonly text: string

75	 * fields needed to present it: a `notice` must record its one-line
76	 * account, a `snapshot` its sections. Omitting `form` stays valid — an
77	 * undeclared context is the documented default.

151	/** A tool-result specialization whose model-facing block retains call correlation. */
152	export interface ToolResultMessage extends Message {
153	  readonly role: 'user'
154	  readonly content: [ToolResultBlock]

158	type NewMessage = Omit<Message, 'id'>
159	type NewUserMessage = Omit<UserMessage, 'id' | 'role'>

167	 * @returns an immutable snapshot that preserves the identity.
168	 */

170	  return deepFreeze(structuredClone(message))

173	/**
174	 * Create one identified message and freeze it before publication.
175	 * @param input - complete role, content, and source for a new message.
176	 * @returns an immutable message with a fresh stable identity.
177	 */
178	export function createMessage<T extends NewMessage>(
179	  input: T & { readonly id?: never },
180	): T & Pick<Message, 'id'> {

182	    ...input,

192	export function createUserMessage<T extends NewUserMessage>(
193	  input: T & { readonly id?: never; readonly role?: never },

196	    ...input,
197	    role: 'user',

201	/**
202	 * Create one identified model-produced assistant message and freeze it before publication.
203	 * @param input - complete content plus the provider, model, and optional replay state for a new assistant message.
204	 * @returns an immutable assistant message with fixed role/source tags and a fresh stable identity.
205	 */
206	export function createAssistantMessage(
207	  input: NewAssistantMessage & { readonly id?: never; readonly role?: never },
208	): AssistantMessage {
209	  return createMessage({
210	    role: 'assistant',
211	    content: input.content,

219	/** Input whose acceptance creates one tool-result message. */
220	export interface ToolResultMessageInput {
221	  readonly callId: CallId
222	  readonly content: ContentBlock[]

228	 * @param input - call identity, raw result blocks, and outcome.
229	 * @returns an immutable user-role tool-result message.
230	 */
231	export function createToolResultMessage(input: ToolResultMessageInput): ToolResultMessage {
232	  return createUserMessage({
233	    source: { kind: 'tool', callId: input.callId },
234	    content: [{
235	      type: 'tool-result',
236	      toolCallId: input.callId,
237	      content: input.content,
238	      isError: input.isError,
239	    }],
240	  })

243	/**
244	 * Whether a stream chunk carries visible model output (the first-token
245	 * boundary shared by client step timing and the whole-log sessionStats
246	 * projection). Empty deltas (heartbeats, empty tool-call frames) do not count
247	 * as a first token.
248	 * @param chunk - the stream chunk to test.
249	 * @returns true when the chunk contains a non-empty text/reasoning/tool delta.
250	 */
251	export function isTokenDelta(chunk: StreamChunk): boolean {
252	  switch (chunk.type) {
253	    case 'text-delta':
254	    case 'reasoning-delta':
255	      return chunk.text !== ''
256	    case 'tool-call-delta':
257	      return chunk.argumentsDelta !== '' || chunk.name !== undefined
258	    default:
259	      return false
260	  }
261	}

1	/**
2	 * Harness error base with a stable machine-routable code and chained cause.
3	 * Package errors extend it so tool results and replay can retain failure class.
4	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/error
5	 */
6	
7	/**
8	 * Base class for all harness errors. Carries a `code` (stable, programmatic —
9	 * e.g. `NO_ADAPTER`, `INVALID_ARGS`, `INVARIANT`) distinct from the
10	 * human-readable `message`, and supports `cause` chaining via the standard
11	 * `ErrorOptions`. `name` defaults to the subclass constructor name.
12	 */
13	export class HarnessError extends Error {
14	  /** Stable machine-routable failure class (e.g. `RATE_LIMIT`); route on this, never by parsing `message`. */
15	  readonly code: string
16	
17	  constructor(message: string, code: string, options?: ErrorOptions) {
18	    super(message, options)
19	    this.code = code
20	    this.name = new.target.name
21	  }
22	}
23	
24	/** Canonical provider-neutral code for a model request rejected because its context window was exceeded. */
25	export const CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED_CODE = 'CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED'
26	
27	/** Canonical provider-neutral code for an exhausted account quota or balance. */
28	export const QUOTA_EXCEEDED_CODE = 'QUOTA'
29	
30	/**
31	 * Canonical provider-neutral code for a response that completed normally but
32	 * carried no content blocks at all. Providers occasionally emit a degenerate
33	 * completion (a terminal stop with zero output); adapters classify it as this
34	 * failure instead of yielding an empty assistant message, because an empty
35	 * message silently ends the turn with nothing for the user or the loop to act
36	 * on. The attempt produced nothing durable, so retry policy treats it as safe
37	 * to repeat.
38	 */
39	export const EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE = 'EMPTY_RESPONSE'
40	
41	/**
42	 * Canonical provider-neutral code for a credential that was supplied but
43	 * cannot be used — malformed rather than absent. Distinct from
44	 * `MISSING_CREDENTIAL` because the fix differs: correct the stored value
45	 * rather than supply one. Deliberately outside the default retryable set —
46	 * a malformed credential fails identically on every attempt.
47	 */
48	export const INVALID_CREDENTIAL_CODE = 'INVALID_CREDENTIAL'
49	
50	/** Structured codes and plain phrases that explicitly name a context bound being exceeded. */
51	const STRUCTURED_CONTEXT_OVERFLOW = new RegExp(
52	  String.raw`(?:^|[^a-z0-9])context[\s_-](?:length|window)[\s_-]`
53	  + String.raw`(?:exceed(?:ed|s)?|overflow(?:ed)?|limit[\s_-]exceeded)(?:$|[^a-z0-9])`,
54	  'i',
55	)
56	
57	/** Request-size wording that ties "too large" directly to model context capacity. */
58	const TOO_LARGE_FOR_CONTEXT = new RegExp(
59	  String.raw`\b(?:request|prompt|input|messages?)\s+(?:is\s+|are\s+)?`
60	  + String.raw`too\s+(?:large|long)\s+for\s+(?:(?:this|the)\s+)?`
61	  + String.raw`(?:model(?:'s)?\s+)?context(?:\s+window)?\b`,
62	  'i',
63	)
64	
65	/** "Exceeds" wording is safe only when its object is explicitly the model context. */
66	const EXCEEDS_MODEL_CONTEXT = new RegExp(
67	  String.raw`\b(?:input|prompt|request|messages?)\b.{0,40}`
68	  + String.raw`\b(?:exceed(?:s|ed)?|overflows?|is\s+larger\s+than)\b.{0,40}`
69	  + String.raw`\b(?:the\s+)?(?:model(?:'s)?\s+)?context(?:\s+(?:length|window))?\b`,
70	  'i',
71	)
72	
73	/**
74	 * Recognize the context-overflow wording used by OpenAI-compatible providers
75	 * and library adapters. Adapters pass all available provider code, type, and
76	 * message text so both thrown and in-band delivery styles share one classifier.
77	 * @param detail - provider error code/type/message text joined into one string.
78	 * @returns true when the detail identifies a request exceeding the model context window.
79	 */
80	export function isContextWindowExceededError(detail: string): boolean {
81	  return STRUCTURED_CONTEXT_OVERFLOW.test(detail)
82	    || /\b(?:maximum|max)(?:\s+(?:allowed|supported))?\s+context\s+(?:length|window)\b/i.test(detail)
83	    || TOO_LARGE_FOR_CONTEXT.test(detail)
84	    || /\b(?:input|prompt|request)\s+(?:is\s+)?too\s+(?:long|large)\s+for\s+(?:this|the)\s+model\b/i.test(detail)
85	    || EXCEEDS_MODEL_CONTEXT.test(detail)
86	}
87	
88	/**
89	 * Recognize provider wording that identifies an exhausted account quota rather
90	 * than a transient request-rate limit.
91	 * @param detail - provider error code/type/message text joined into one string.
92	 * @returns true only for terminal quota, balance, credit, budget, or usage-limit wording.
93	 */
94	export function isQuotaExceededError(detail: string): boolean {
95	  return /\binsufficient[\s_-]+(?:quota|balance|credits?)\b/i.test(detail)
96	    || /\b(?:quota|usage[\s_-]+limit)[\s_-]+(?:exceeded|exhausted|reached)\b/i.test(detail)
97	    || /\bexceed(?:ed|s)?[\s_-]+(?:(?:your|the)[\s_-]+)?(?:current[\s_-]+)?quota\b/i.test(detail)
98	    || /\b(?:balance|credits?)[\s_-]+(?:exhausted|depleted)\b/i.test(detail)
99	    || /\bout[\s_-]+of[\s_-]+(?:credits?|budget)\b/i.test(detail)
100	}
101	
102	/**
103	 * Render a thrown value with its full `cause` chain and AggregateError
104	 * members, so transport wrappers like undici's `TypeError: fetch failed`
105	 * surface the underlying failure instead of masking it. Plain structured
106	 * failures render their own data-backed `message`. Diagnostic-surface
107	 * rendering only (messages, notices, logs) — never parse the result; route on
108	 * {@link HarnessError.code}.
109	 * @param value - the caught value (`unknown` in catch clauses).
110	 * @returns the outermost message first, each cause appended with `: ` (skipped
111	 * when it repeats the wrapper message verbatim), and AggregateError members
112	 * bracketed and `; `-joined.
113	 */
114	export function errorChain(value: unknown): string {
115	  // Tracks the active recursion path (entries removed on exit), so only true
116	  // cycles are flagged and a diamond-shared cause still renders in full.
117	  const path = new Set<unknown>()
118	  const render = (current: unknown): string => {
119	    if (path.has(current)) return '<circular cause>'
120	    path.add(current)
121	    try {
122	      if (!(current instanceof Error)) {
123	        if (typeof current === 'object' && current !== null) {
124	          const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(current, 'message')
125	          if (descriptor !== undefined && 'value' in descriptor && typeof descriptor.value === 'string') {
126	            return descriptor.value
127	          }
128	        }
129	        return String(current)
130	      }
131	      const message = current.message === '' ? current.name : current.message
132	      const members = current instanceof AggregateError && current.errors.length > 0
133	        ? ` [${current.errors.map(render).join('; ')}]`
134	        : ''
135	      const causeText = current.cause === undefined || current.cause === null
136	        ? ''
137	        : render(current.cause)
138	      // Wrappers like `new HarnessError(String(value), code, { cause: value })`
139	      // repeat their cause verbatim; rendering it again would only add noise.
140	      const cause = causeText === '' || causeText === message ? '' : `: ${causeText}`
141	      return `${message}${members}${cause}`
142	    } catch {
143	      // Only hostile coercion or hostile accessors (a throwing toString /
144	      // Symbol.toPrimitive on a non-Error, or a throwing message/name/cause/
145	      // errors getter on an Error subclass): this renderer feeds UI notices
146	      // and logs, so nothing may escape. Inner frames catch their own throws,
147	      // so only the hostile node collapses, not the whole chain.
148	      return '<unrenderable value>'
149	    } finally {
150	      path.delete(current)
151	    }
152	  }
153	  return render(value)
154	}
155	
156	/**
157	 * Narrow an arbitrary thrown value to a HarnessError (for `instanceof` at runtime boundaries).
158	 * @param value - the caught value (`unknown` in catch clauses).
159	 * @returns true only for real instances; duck-typed or cross-realm errors do not narrow.
160	 */
161	export function isHarnessError(value: unknown): value is HarnessError {
162	  return value instanceof HarnessError
163	}

1	/**
2	 * Generic pi-ai-backed LLM adapter plugin. One plugin instance owns a dict of
3	 * provider routes; a route naming an installed pi-ai provider inherits that
4	 * provider's endpoint, protocol, and model catalog as defaults, and a route
5	 * pi-ai does not ship is declared outright. Profile facts resolve per request
6	 * over the optional `llm-pi-ai` user-settings section and the optional
7	 * credential seam, so a changed key, endpoint, model, or knob reaches the next
8	 * request without a restart; a changed *route set* (or a route's
9	 * registration-captured retry policy) re-registers the same adapter instance
10	 * in place.
11	 *
12	 * ```yaml
13	 * - id: llm
14	 *   name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai'
15	 *   config:
16	 *     providers:
17	 *       # Catalog route: everything but the credential comes from pi-ai.
18	 *       openai:
19	 *         apiKeyEnv: OPENAI_API_KEY
20	 *         retryPolicy:
21	 *           mode: normal
22	 *           maxRetries: 2
23	 *       # Catalog route with the catalog narrowed and one capacity corrected.
24	 *       anthropic:
25	 *         apiKeyEnv: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
26	 *         models:
27	 *           - id: claude-sonnet-4-5
28	 *             contextWindow: 200000
29	 *       # Hand-declared route: pi-ai ships nothing under this key.
30	 *       acme-gateway:
31	 *         displayName: Acme Gateway
32	 *         apiKeyEnv: ACME_GATEWAY_API_KEY
33	 *         api: openai-completions
34	 *         baseURL: https://gateway.acme.example/v1
35	 *         # Reasoning dialect for a URL pi-ai cannot recognize.
36	 *         compat:
37	 *           thinkingFormat: deepseek
38	 *         models:
39	 *           - id: acme-large
40	 *             name: Acme Large
41	 *             contextWindow: 65536
42	 *             maxTokens: 4096
43	 *           - id: acme-think
44	 *             name: Acme Think
45	 *             contextWindow: 262144
46	 *             maxTokens: 32768
47	 *             # key = selectable level, value = wire spelling; only off may
48	 *             # leave the value empty (supported, send nothing).
49	 *             reasoningEfforts:
50	 *               off:
51	 *               high: high
52	 *               max: ultra
53	 * ```
54	 *
55	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai
56	 */
57	
58	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
59	import { launchEnvironmentOf } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-launch-environment'
60	import { assertUsableApiKey, LlmError } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
61	import type { AdapterRegistrationHandle, DirectoryRegistrationHandle, LlmConfigurableProvider } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
62	import { deepEqualJson, installSettingsSection, settingsNamespace } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings'
63	import { PiAiAdapter } from './adapter.ts'
64	import { catalogProviderIds, catalogProviderTakesApiKey } from './catalog.ts'
65	import { assertServiceable, Config, resolveProfiles } from './config.ts'
66	import type { ResolvedPiAiProviderProfile } from './config.ts'
67	import { discoverModels } from './discovery.ts'
68	
69	export { PiAiAdapter } from './adapter.ts'
70	export type { PiAiAdapterOptions } from './adapter.ts'
71	export { Config } from './config.ts'
72	export type {
73	  PiAiCompatProfile,
74	  PiAiModality,
75	  PiAiModelOverride,
76	  PiAiModelProfile,
77	  PiAiProviderProfile,
78	  PiAiReasoningEfforts,
79	  PiAiThinkingFormat,
80	  ResolvedPiAiProviderProfile,
81	} from './config.ts'
82	export { supportedProtocols } from './provider.ts'
83	
84	export const name = 'llm-pi-ai'
85	export const inject = ['llm']
86	
87	const NS = settingsNamespace('llm-pi-ai')
88	
89	/**
90	 * The registry captures these per route; a change here must re-register.
91	 * Sorted by provider so a settings document that merely reorders its keys is
92	 * not mistaken for a route change.
93	 */
94	function registrationFacts(profiles: ReadonlyMap<string, ResolvedPiAiProviderProfile>): unknown {
95	  return [...profiles.entries()]
96	    // `displayName` rides along because the registry hands it to every selector
97	    // through `providerInfo()`: a rename that did not re-register would leave
98	    // the old label showing until some unrelated fact happened to change.
99	    .map(([provider, profile]) => ({
100	      provider,
101	      displayName: profile.displayName,
102	      retryPolicy: profile.retryPolicy,
103	    }))
104	    .sort((left, right) => left.provider.localeCompare(right.provider))
105	}
106	
107	/**
108	 * The configurable-provider directory: every installed catalog route this
109	 * adapter can authenticate, plus every route the current profiles declare. A
110	 * hand-declared route has no catalog entry, so without this union it would
111	 * have no settings address and configuration surfaces could neither show nor
112	 * edit it.
113	 *
114	 * The profile half is unconditional, which is what keeps a route already
115	 * stored against a withheld provider editable and deletable rather than
116	 * stranded in the settings document with nothing on the page to remove it.
117	 * @param profiles - the currently resolved provider profiles.
118	 * @returns the directory entries in catalog order, declared routes last.
119	 */
120	function directoryEntries(
121	  profiles: ReadonlyMap<string, ResolvedPiAiProviderProfile>,
122	): LlmConfigurableProvider[] {
123	  const catalog = new Set(catalogProviderIds())
124	  const entries = new Map<string, LlmConfigurableProvider>()
125	  const declare = (provider: string, displayName: string): void => {
126	    entries.set(provider, {
127	      provider,
128	      displayName,
129	      settingsNs: NS,
130	      settingsPath: ['providers', provider],
131	      // Membership of the installed catalog, not of the settings document:
132	      // narrowing a shipped provider's models stores a profile too, and that
133	      // route is still one pi-ai knows.
134	      declared: !catalog.has(provider),
135	    })
136	  }
137	  // A provider whose only native method is OAuth leaves this adapter nothing
138	  // to authenticate with, so offering it would put a card on the settings page
139	  // whose own posture — no key, credentials discovered by the provider — fails
140	  // every request. Catalog *membership* is unaffected, so `declare` above still
141	  // answers what pi-ai ships.
142	  for (const provider of catalog) {
143	    if (catalogProviderTakesApiKey(provider)) declare(provider, provider)
144	  }
145	  for (const [provider, profile] of profiles) declare(provider, profile.displayName)
146	  return [...entries.values()]
147	}
148	
149	/** Register one generic pi-ai adapter for all configured provider routes. */
150	export function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): void {
151	  let current: () => Config = () => config
152	  let lastRaw: Config | undefined
153	  let memoized: ReadonlyMap<string, ResolvedPiAiProviderProfile> | undefined
154	  /**
155	   * The resolved profiles for the current configuration, memoized by the raw
156	   * snapshot's identity — which is also what makes the adapter's own snapshot
157	   * stable across operations that observe no change.
158	   *
159	   * No fallback for an unserviceable snapshot lives here: the section schema
160	   * resolves the whole profile set, so a write that could not be served is
161	   * refused where it is written, and the settings seam keeps a namespace's
162	   * last good value for a stored section that fails. Anything reaching this
163	   * point has already resolved once.
164	   */
165	  const profiles = (): ReadonlyMap<string, ResolvedPiAiProviderProfile> => {
166	    const raw = current()
167	    if (raw === lastRaw && memoized !== undefined) return memoized
168	    const next = resolveProfiles(raw.providers)
169	    lastRaw = raw
170	    memoized = next
171	    return next
172	  }
173	  profiles()
174	
175	  const resolveApiKey = async (
176	    provider: string,
177	    profile: ResolvedPiAiProviderProfile,
178	  ): Promise<string | undefined> => {
179	    const ref = profile.apiKeyEnv
180	    // Only a profile that names no credential at all defers to pi-ai's
181	    // provider-native discovery. Once one is named, a miss must fail loud:
182	    // handing pi-ai `undefined` would let it pick up an unrelated ambient key
183	    // (OPENAI_API_KEY and friends), billing another tenant for a request the
184	    // deployment meant to authenticate differently.
185	    if (ref === undefined) return undefined
186	    const credentials = ctx.get('credentials')
187	    const hit = credentials !== undefined
188	      ? (await credentials.resolve(ref))?.value
189	      // Without the seam the environment is the whole credential plane.
190	      : launchEnvironmentOf(ctx).get(ref)?.value
191	    if (hit !== undefined && hit.length > 0) return assertUsableApiKey(hit, 'llm-pi-ai', ref)
192	    throw new LlmError(
193	      `llm-pi-ai: no credential for provider route "${provider}"; its profile resolves ${ref}, which is not`
194	      + ` set — store ${ref} through the credentials service (the web Models page writes it) or export it,`
195	      + ' and remove apiKeyEnv only if this provider should authenticate from pi-ai\'s own environment discovery',
196	      'MISSING_CREDENTIAL',
197	    )
198	  }
199	
200	  const adapter = new PiAiAdapter({
201	    profiles,
202	    resolveApiKey,
203	    resolveAttachments: () => ctx.get('attachments'),
204	  })
205	  // The full installed catalog is configurable from the moment the plugin
206	  // mounts — dormant or not — so configuration surfaces can offer every
207	  // pi-ai provider before any route exists. Hand-declared routes join it as
208	  // profiles appear, and leave with them.
209	  let directory: DirectoryRegistrationHandle | undefined
210	  let directoryFacts: unknown
211	  const ensureDirectory = (): void => {
212	    const entries = directoryEntries(profiles())
213	    if (deepEqualJson(entries, directoryFacts)) return
214	    // Atomic replace, never dispose-then-register: a route another adapter
215	    // family already declares (a profile keyed `deepseek-official`) would
216	    // otherwise leave this plugin's whole directory withdrawn and the Models
217	    // page empty. The candidate set is validated first, so a collision keeps
218	    // the previous entries serving and only costs a diagnostic.
219	    if (directory === undefined) {
220	      directory = ctx.llm.registerConfigurableProviders(entries)
221	    } else {
222	      directory.replace(entries)
223	    }
224	    directoryFacts = entries
225	  }
226	  ensureDirectory()
227	  /**
228	   * The credential a named route already resolves, for an interrogation whose
229	   * draft carries none. A route being declared for the first time names no
230	   * profile yet, and a profile that names no credential defers to pi-ai's own
231	   * discovery, so both answer `undefined` and the endpoint is asked
232	   * unauthenticated — the same posture a request to that route would take.
233	   */
234	  const storedApiKey = async (provider: string | undefined): Promise<string | undefined> => {
235	    if (provider === undefined) return undefined
236	    const profile = profiles().get(provider)
237	    if (profile === undefined) return undefined
238	    return resolveApiKey(provider, profile)
239	  }
240	  // Interrogating an endpoint is a configuration-time action over a draft, so
241	  // it is offered for the whole namespace rather than per route: the provider
242	  // a surface is adding does not exist yet. The draft is the whole request
243	  // except the credential: a configuration surface edits a redacted descriptor
244	  // and never holds a stored secret, so an already-configured route supplies
245	  // its own here rather than being interrogated unauthenticated.
246	  ctx.llm.registerModelDiscovery(NS, request => discoverModels(request, () => storedApiKey(request.provider)))
247	  // Route effects bind to this apply fiber via the stable `ctx` reference,
248	  // even when a swap runs inside the scoped settings callback below. A bare
249	  // mount (zero routes) is the dormant posture: nothing registers until a
250	  // settings section supplies profiles, and routes drop when it empties.
251	  let registration: AdapterRegistrationHandle | undefined
252	  let registeredFacts: unknown
253	  const ensureRegistrationFacts = (): void => {
254	    const facts = registrationFacts(profiles())
255	    if (deepEqualJson(facts, registeredFacts)) return
256	    // The registry captures the route set and each route's retry policy at
257	    // registration, so a change to either must re-register. The swap is
258	    // atomic (same adapter instance, validated before anything moves): a
259	    // conflicting route leaves the previous routes serving requests, and
260	    // `registeredFacts` only advances once the registry actually holds the
261	    // new set — so returning to a working configuration always re-applies.
262	    const routes = [...profiles().keys()]
263	    if (registration === undefined) {
264	      // Dormant bare mount: nothing is registered until a section supplies
265	      // profiles, and an empty section keeps it that way.
266	      if (routes.length === 0) {
267	        registeredFacts = facts
268	        return
269	      }
270	      registration = ctx.llm.registerAdapter(routes, adapter)
271	    } else {
272	      registration.replace(routes)
273	    }
274	    registeredFacts = facts
275	  }
276	  ensureRegistrationFacts()
277	
278	  installSettingsSection(ctx, NS, Config, config, {
279	    // Refuse an unserviceable section where it is written: without this a
280	    // schema-valid profile the adapter cannot serve would be stored and then

282	    validate: assertServiceable,

289	      // adapter family owns is stored successfully and only fails at this swap.
290	      // Without its own diagnostic that refusal reaches the operator as a
291	      // generic "settings: watcher failed", naming neither the route nor why it
292	      // is not serving. The previous routes keep serving either way.
293	      try {
294	        ensureRegistrationFacts()
295	      } catch (error) {
296	        ctx.logger.error('llm-pi-ai: keeping the previously registered routes after a refused update')
297	        ctx.logger.error(error)
298	      }
299	      // The directory follows the profiles the registry accepted, so a route
300	      // that failed to register is not advertised as configurable. A refused
301	      // directory swap is contained here for the same reason the registry's
302	      // is: the previous entries keep serving, and `directoryFacts` stays put

304	      try {
305	        ensureDirectory()
306	      } catch (error) {
307	        ctx.logger.error('llm-pi-ai: keeping the previous configurable-provider directory after a refused update')
308	        ctx.logger.error(error)
309	      }
310	    },
311	  })

8	import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events'
9	import { extname } from 'node:path'
10	import type {
11	  SpawnedProcess,
12	  SpawnOptions,
13	} from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk'
14	import {
15	  scrubbedParentEnv,
16	  type SubprocessHandle,
17	  type SubprocessSpawnSpec,
18	} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess'
19	
20	const WINDOWS_BATCH_EXECUTABLE_ENV = 'DSH_CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE'
21	
22	function thrown(value: unknown): Error {
23	  /* v8 ignore next -- the subprocess seam rejects with Error. */
24	  return value instanceof Error ? value : new Error(String(value))
25	}
26	
27	/**
28	 * Encode the SDK's complete child environment as a subprocess overlay.
29	 * @param env - SDK-composed child environment after its removals and replacements.
30	 * @returns explicit values plus tombstones for surviving ambient names the SDK removed.
31	 */
32	export function sdkEnvironmentOverlay(
33	  env: SpawnOptions['env'],
34	): NodeJS.ProcessEnv {
35	  const overlay: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = { ...env }
36	  for (const name of Object.keys(scrubbedParentEnv())) {
37	    if (!(name in env)) overlay[name] = undefined
38	  }
39	  return overlay
40	}
41	
42	/**
43	 * Translate one official SDK spawn request to the shared process owner.
44	 * @param options - command, arguments, workspace, environment, and forwarded signal from the SDK.
45	 * @param graceMs - process-tree termination grace.
46	 * @param platform - host platform selecting the Windows batch-shim boundary.
47	 * @returns the fully explicit shared subprocess request.
48	 * @remarks The batch-shim path quotes only the resolved executable. The pinned SDK
49	 * supplies fixed flag arguments without cmd metacharacters; cmd reparses that tail.
50	 */
51	export function claudeSpawnSpec(
52	  options: SpawnOptions,
53	  graceMs: number,
54	  platform: NodeJS.Platform = process.platform,
55	): SubprocessSpawnSpec {
56	  if (options.cwd === undefined || options.cwd.length === 0) {
57	    throw new Error('subagent-claude-code: SDK spawn request omitted its workspace')
58	  }
59	  const extension = extname(options.command).toLowerCase()
60	  const batchShim = platform === 'win32' && (extension === '.cmd' || extension === '.bat')
61	  const env = sdkEnvironmentOverlay(options.env)
62	  const argv = batchShim
63	    ? ['cmd.exe', '/d', '/v:off', '/s', '/c', `%${WINDOWS_BATCH_EXECUTABLE_ENV}%`, ...options.args]
64	    : [options.command, ...options.args]
65	  if (batchShim) env[WINDOWS_BATCH_EXECUTABLE_ENV] = `"${options.command}"`
66	  return {
67	    argv,
68	    cwd: options.cwd,
69	    stdio: { stdin: 'pipe', stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'inherit' },
70	    graceMs,
71	    signal: options.signal,
72	    env,
73	  }
74	}

76	/**
77	 * SDK-facing view of one shared managed process. Protocol transport remains
78	 * in the official SDK; this adapter only projects streams and exit events.
79	 */
80	export class ManagedClaudeCodeProcess implements SpawnedProcess {
81	  readonly stdin
82	  readonly stdout
83	  private readonly events = new EventEmitter()
84	  private exitCodeValue: number | null = null
85	  private signalCodeValue: NodeJS.Signals | null = null
86	  private killRequested = false
87	
88	  /**
89	   * Project a managed process with piped stdin and stdout.
90	   * @param child - shared handle that remains the process-tree authority.
91	   */
92	  constructor(private readonly child: SubprocessHandle) {
93	    this.stdin = child.stdin as NonNullable<SubprocessHandle['stdin']>
94	    this.stdout = child.stdout as NonNullable<SubprocessHandle['stdout']>
95	    // EventEmitter gives `error` special throw semantics without a listener.
96	    // The SDK attaches its listener synchronously after custom spawn returns,
97	    // while this no-op also contains an already-rejected spawn handle.
98	    this.events.on('error', () => {})
99	    void child.done.then(
100	      (outcome) => {
101	        this.exitCodeValue = outcome.exitCode
102	        this.signalCodeValue = outcome.signal
103	        this.events.emit('exit', outcome.exitCode, outcome.signal)
104	      },
105	      (error: unknown) => {
106	        this.events.emit('error', thrown(error))
107	      },
108	    )
109	  }
110	
111	  /** Whether the SDK has requested managed tree termination. */
112	  get killed(): boolean {
113	    return this.killRequested
114	  }
115	
116	  /** Direct-child exit code, or null while running or after signal exit. */
117	  get exitCode(): number | null {
118	    return this.exitCodeValue
119	  }
120	
121	  /** Direct-child terminating signal, if any. */
122	  get signalCode(): NodeJS.Signals | null {
123	    return this.signalCodeValue
124	  }
125	
126	  /**
127	   * Route the SDK's termination request to the tree-scoped process owner.
128	   * @param _signal - SDK-selected signal; the shared seam owns its escalation ladder.
129	   * @returns false only after exit or a previous termination request.
130	   */
131	  kill(_signal: NodeJS.Signals): boolean {
132	    if (
133	      this.killRequested
134	      || this.exitCodeValue !== null
135	      || this.signalCodeValue !== null
136	    ) {
137	      return false
138	    }
139	    this.killRequested = true
140	    this.child.terminate()
141	    return true
142	  }
143	
144	  /** Register a persistent process lifecycle listener. */
145	  on(
146	    event: 'exit' | 'error',
147	    listener: ((code: number | null, signal: NodeJS.Signals | null) => void)
148	      | ((error: Error) => void),
149	  ): void {
150	    this.events.on(event, listener)
151	  }
152	
153	  /** Register a one-shot process lifecycle listener. */
154	  once(
155	    event: 'exit' | 'error',
156	    listener: ((code: number | null, signal: NodeJS.Signals | null) => void)
157	      | ((error: Error) => void),
158	  ): void {
159	    this.events.once(event, listener)
160	  }
161	
162	  /** Remove a process lifecycle listener. */
163	  off(
164	    event: 'exit' | 'error',
165	    listener: ((code: number | null, signal: NodeJS.Signals | null) => void)
166	      | ((error: Error) => void),
167	  ): void {
168	    this.events.off(event, listener)
169	  }
170	}

3	 * real CLI process under the shared subprocess owner, map only strict SDK
4	 * success to completion, and dispose to whole-tree quiescence.

6	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code/run
7	 */

9	import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
10	import {
11	  query as officialQuery,
12	  type Options,
13	  type Query,
14	  type SDKMessage,
15	  type SDKResultMessage,
16	  type SpawnOptions,
17	} from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk'
18	import type { ContentBlock } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
19	import { SessionId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'

21	  settleRunResult,
22	  subprocessRunHandle,
23	  type SubagentResult,
24	  type SubagentRun,

31	  type SubprocessSpawnSpec,

35	  ManagedClaudeCodeProcess,

38	/** Default POSIX grace between subprocess termination tiers. */

40	
41	/* jscpd:ignore-start -- sibling providers intentionally keep product-private
42	 * run inputs and error normalization instead of adding a shared lifecycle owner. */
43	/** Fully resolved inputs for one official Claude Agent SDK query. */
44	export interface ClaudeCodeRunSpec {
45	  /** Parent Session workspace supplied to the SDK and real CLI. */
46	  readonly cwd: string
47	  /** Exact native Claude Code executable resolved from the host PATH. */
48	  readonly executable: string
49	  /** Explicit deployment/test environment layered after shared scrubbing. */
50	  readonly env: Record<string, string>
51	  /** Subprocess termination grace passed to the shared process-tree owner. */
52	  readonly disposeGraceMs: number
53	  /** Shared subprocess service spawn operation. */
54	  readonly spawn: (spec: SubprocessSpawnSpec) => SubprocessHandle
55	  /** Diagnostic sink for a post-publication error flattened into a result. */
56	  readonly onError?: (error: Error, stopReason: SubagentStopReason) => void
57	}
58	
59	function thrown(value: unknown): Error {
60	  /* v8 ignore next -- typed SDK and subprocess failures reject with Error. */
61	  return value instanceof Error ? value : new Error(String(value))
62	}
63	/* jscpd:ignore-end */
64	
65	/**
66	 * Validate and preserve the one-shot task before crossing the SDK boundary.
67	 * @param prompt - task content accepted from the shared subagent service.
68	 * @returns the exact text sequence as one SDK prompt.
69	 */
70	export function textTask(prompt: readonly ContentBlock[]): string {
71	  if (prompt.length === 0) {
72	    throw new Error('subagent-claude-code: the one-shot task must contain only text blocks')
73	  }
74	  const texts: string[] = []
75	  for (const block of prompt) {
76	    if (block.type !== 'text') {
77	      throw new Error('subagent-claude-code: the one-shot task must contain only text blocks')
78	    }
79	    texts.push(block.text)
80	  }
81	  if (texts.every(text => text.trim().length === 0)) {
82	    throw new Error('subagent-claude-code: the one-shot task must not be empty')
83	  }
84	  return texts.join('')

87	/**
88	 * Strictly derive the only SDK result that can complete a shared run.
89	 * @param message - an official discriminated result union.
90	 * @returns exact final text for a successful, non-error result.
91	 */
92	export function successfulResult(message: SDKResultMessage): string {
93	  if (
94	    message.subtype !== 'success'
95	    || message.is_error
96	    || message.result.trim().length === 0
97	  ) {
98	    const detail = message.subtype === 'success'
99	      ? 'success result was marked as an error or contained no answer'
100	      : message.errors.join('; ') || message.subtype
101	    throw new Error(`subagent-claude-code: Claude Code failed: ${detail}`)
102	  }
103	  return message.result
104	}

106	/**
107	 * Consume the complete SDK stream and require one strict success plus normal
108	 * iterator completion.
109	 * @param query - published official SDK query.
110	 * @returns the completed shared result.
111	 */
112	export async function consumeClaudeQuery(
113	  query: AsyncIterable<SDKMessage>,
114	): Promise<SubagentResult> {
115	  let answer: string | undefined
116	  for await (const message of query) {
117	    if (message.type !== 'result') continue

119	  }
120	  if (answer === undefined) {
121	    throw new Error('subagent-claude-code: Claude Code ended without a result')
122	  }

134	 */
135	export async function disposeClaudeCodeChild(
136	  query: Pick<Query, 'close'> | undefined,
137	  child: SubprocessHandle,
138	): Promise<void> {
139	  const failures: Error[] = []
140	  try {
141	    query?.close()

143	    failures.push(thrown(error))

153	  }
154	  try {
155	    await child.done
156	  } catch (error: unknown) {
157	    failures.push(thrown(error))
158	  }

160	  const firstFailure = failures[0]
161	  if (failures.length === 1 && firstFailure !== undefined) throw firstFailure

172	 * @param spec - Workspace, environment, process service, and disposal policy.
173	 * @param controller - per-run cancellation owner.
174	 * @param capture - receives the real managed child synchronously from the SDK hook.
175	 * @returns options that inherit native settings while disabling persistence and user questions.
176	 */
177	export function claudeQueryOptions(
178	  spec: ClaudeCodeRunSpec,
179	  controller: AbortController,
180	  capture: (child: SubprocessHandle) => void,
181	): Options {
182	  return {
183	    abortController: controller,
184	    cwd: spec.cwd,
185	    pathToClaudeCodeExecutable: spec.executable,
186	    env: { ...scrubbedParentEnv(), ...spec.env },
187	    persistSession: false,
188	    disallowedTools: ['AskUserQuestion'],
189	    spawnClaudeCodeProcess: (options: SpawnOptions) => {
190	      const child = spec.spawn(claudeSpawnSpec(options, spec.disposeGraceMs))
191	      capture(child)
192	      return new ManagedClaudeCodeProcess(child)
193	    },
194	  }
195	}
196	
197	/**
198	 * Start one official Claude Agent SDK query and publish its one-shot run.
199	 * @param request - resolved shared subagent request.
200	 * @param spec - Workspace, environment, process service, and diagnostic policy.
201	 * @returns the published run after both Query and real CLI handle exist.
202	 */
203	export async function startClaudeCodeRun(
204	  request: SubagentStartRequest,
205	  spec: ClaudeCodeRunSpec,
206	): Promise<SubagentRun> {
207	  const prompt = textTask(request.prompt)
208	  if (request.signal.aborted) {
209	    throw new Error('subagent-claude-code: request was aborted before SDK startup')
210	  }
211	
212	  const controller = new AbortController()
213	  const requestCancel = (): void => {
214	    if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
215	      controller.abort(new Error('subagent-claude-code: run cancelled locally'))
216	    }
217	  }
218	  const onAbort = (): void => { requestCancel() }
219	  request.signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true })
220	
221	  let child: SubprocessHandle | undefined
222	  let query: Query | undefined
223	  try {
224	    query = officialQuery({
225	      prompt,
226	      options: claudeQueryOptions(spec, controller, (captured) => {
227	        child = captured
228	      }),
229	    })
230	    if (child === undefined || child.pid <= 0) {
231	      throw new Error(
232	        'subagent-claude-code: official SDK did not publish a controllable Claude Code process',
233	      )
234	    }
235	    if (controller.signal.aborted) {
236	      throw new Error('subagent-claude-code: request was aborted before SDK startup')
237	    }
238	  } catch (error: unknown) {
239	    request.signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort)
240	    const cancelledBeforeCleanup = controller.signal.aborted
241	    requestCancel()
242	    if (child !== undefined) {
243	      try {
244	        await disposeClaudeCodeChild(query, child)
245	      } catch (disposeError: unknown) {
246	        throw new AggregateError(
247	          [thrown(error), thrown(disposeError)],
248	          'subagent-claude-code: startup failed and CLI cleanup also failed',
249	        )
250	      }
251	    } else if (query !== undefined) {
252	      try {
253	        query.close()
254	      } catch (disposeError: unknown) {
255	        throw new AggregateError(
256	          [thrown(error), thrown(disposeError)],
257	          'subagent-claude-code: startup failed and query cleanup also failed',
258	        )
259	      }
260	    }
261	    // oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/no-unnecessary-condition -- the request can abort while process cleanup is awaited.
262	    if (cancelledBeforeCleanup || request.signal.aborted) {
263	      throw new Error('subagent-claude-code: request was aborted before SDK startup')
264	    }
265	    throw thrown(error)
266	  }
267	
268	  const publishedQuery = query
269	  const publishedChild = child
270	  const result = settleRunResult({
271	    attempt: () => consumeClaudeQuery(publishedQuery),
272	    collectOutput: () => [],
273	    cancelled: () => controller.signal.aborted,
274	    onError: spec.onError,
275	    signal: request.signal,
276	    onAbort,
277	  })
278	
279	  return subprocessRunHandle({
280	    id: SessionId(randomUUID()),
281	    result,
282	    signal: request.signal,

1	/**
2	 * Fixed Claude Code one-shot subagent provider. Every accepted run invokes
3	 * the official Agent SDK in the delegating Session's workspace and places
4	 * the SDK-spawned real CLI under the shared subprocess owner.
5	 *
6	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code
7	 */
8	
9	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
10	import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
11	import { MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-timeout'
12	import {
13	  assertOutOfProcessAllowed,
14	  assertPositiveFinite,
15	  enforceOutOfProcessRefusal,
16	  NO_START_CAPABILITIES,
17	  resolveChildCwd,
18	  type ResolvedSubagentStartRequest,
19	  type SubagentCapabilities,
20	  type SubagentProvider,
21	} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent'
22	import {
23	  DEFAULT_DISPOSE_GRACE_MS,
24	  startClaudeCodeRun,
25	  type ClaudeCodeRunSpec,
26	} from './run.ts'
27	
28	export const name = 'subagent-claude-code'
29	export const inject = ['subagents', 'subprocess']
30	
31	/* jscpd:ignore-start -- sibling product providers intentionally expose the
32	 * same two deployment-owned fields without adding a shared config owner. */
33	/** Deployment-owned environment and process-release bound. */
34	export interface Config {
35	  /**
36	   * Explicit environment entries layered over the subprocess seam's
37	   * credential-scrubbed parent environment.
38	   */
39	  env?: Record<string, string>
40	  /** Grace in milliseconds for Claude Code process-tree termination. */
41	  disposeGraceMs?: number
42	}
43	
44	export const Config: z<Config> = z.object({
45	  env: z.dict(z.string()).default({}),
46	  disposeGraceMs: z.number().default(DEFAULT_DISPOSE_GRACE_MS),
47	})
48	
49	type ResolvedConfig = Required<Config>
50	/* jscpd:ignore-end */
51	
52	/* jscpd:ignore-start -- Cordis registration and shared-seam plumbing mirror
53	 * the Codex sibling; each product's lifecycle remains package-private. */
54	class ClaudeCodeProvider implements SubagentProvider {
55	  readonly name = 'claude-code'
56	  readonly capabilities: SubagentCapabilities = NO_START_CAPABILITIES
57	  readonly inheritsParentContext = false
58	
59	  constructor(
60	    private readonly ctx: Context,
61	    private readonly config: ResolvedConfig,
62	  ) {}
63	
64	  async start(request: ResolvedSubagentStartRequest) {
65	    assertOutOfProcessAllowed(this.ctx, request.parent)
66	    const parentCwd = request.parent.session.header.cwd
67	    if (parentCwd === undefined) {
68	      throw new Error(
69	        'subagent-claude-code: no working directory for the child — delegate from a parent session that has one',
70	      )
71	    }
72	    const executable = await this.ctx.subprocess.resolveExecutable(
73	      'claude',
74	      this.config.env,
75	      request.signal,
76	    )
77	    const spec: ClaudeCodeRunSpec = {
78	      cwd: resolveChildCwd(
79	        'subagent-claude-code',
80	        undefined,
81	        parentCwd,
82	      ),
83	      executable,
84	      env: this.config.env,
85	      disposeGraceMs: this.config.disposeGraceMs,
86	      spawn: spawnSpec => this.ctx.subprocess.spawn(spawnSpec),
87	      onError: (error, stopReason) => {
88	        this.ctx.logger.warn(
89	          `subagent-claude-code: child run failed (${stopReason}): ${error.message}`,
90	        )
91	      },
92	    }
93	    return startClaudeCodeRun(request, spec)
94	  }
95	}
96	
97	/**
98	 * Register the fixed `claude-code` provider.
99	 * @param ctx - context carrying shared subagent and subprocess services.
100	 * @param config - explicit child environment and disposal grace.
101	 */
102	export function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): void {
103	  const resolved = config as ResolvedConfig
104	  assertPositiveFinite(
105	    'subagent-claude-code',
106	    'disposeGraceMs',
107	    resolved.disposeGraceMs,
108	  )
109	  if (resolved.disposeGraceMs > MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS) {
110	    throw new Error(
111	      `subagent-claude-code: disposeGraceMs must be no greater than ${MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS}`,
112	    )
113	  }
114	  ctx.subagents.registerProvider(new ClaudeCodeProvider(ctx, resolved))
115	  enforceOutOfProcessRefusal(ctx)
116	}
117	/* jscpd:ignore-end */

30	 * reads `blocks()` / `message()` / `usage` / `finish` once the stream ends.
31	 *

33	 * an index already closed by `block-end` are ignored (malformed stream) so a
34	 * misbehaving adapter cannot grow memory or corrupt a completed block.

45	   * @param chunk - the next raw chunk, in stream order.
46	   */

48	    switch (chunk.type) {
49	      case 'block-start': {
50	        if (!this.partials.has(chunk.index)) {
51	          this.order.push(chunk.index)

53	            blockType: chunk.blockType,

214	  async * stream(options: GenerateOptions): AsyncIterable<StreamChunk> {
215	    // One resolution per stream call: connection facts and the credential
216	    // freeze here and hold for this whole request, so an in-flight stream
217	    // never observes a configuration change and the next call re-resolves.
218	    // The key resolves *from this snapshot*, so an endpoint and the secret
219	    // sent to it can never come from different configuration generations.

233	      userId,

235	    )[Symbol.asyncIterator]()

237	    try {
238	      while (true) {

240	        if (result.done) {

243	        }

258	      throw new LlmError(`DeepSeek API stream from ${connection.baseURL} failed`, 'TRANSPORT', { cause: error })

261	      if (!exhausted && iterator.return !== undefined) {
262	        try {
263	          await iterator.return()
264	        } catch (_abortedTransportTeardown) {

268	    }

271	  private async * request(
272	    options: GenerateOptions,
273	    signal: AbortSignal,
274	    connection: DeepSeekConnectionOptions,

278	  ): AsyncIterable<StreamChunk> {
