1	# @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-claude-code
2	
3	English | [中文](README.zh.md)
4	
5	Serves the harness LLM seam from a Claude Code installation the operator has already authenticated, so a host with no API key can still run every harness role — implementer agents, validators, judges, program departments, workflow workers, in-process subagents — on that subscription.
6	
7	Every `generate()` on this route is one stateless query to that installation through the official Agent SDK. The harness system prompt becomes the query's system prompt, the conversation and the harness tool definitions become the query's prompt text, and the answer comes back as a structured output this package parses into the seam's `StreamChunk` protocol. The product runs no tool of its own and reads no workspace, so every tool call returns to the harness agent loop and executes under the harness's own tools, session log, read barrier, budget policy, and approvals.
8	
9	The package root exposes the Cordis plugin contract, `ClaudeCodeAdapter`, and the request/response helpers those two use; the SDK is a runtime dependency of this package, not of the seam.
10	
11	## Config
12	
13	```yaml
14	- id: llm-claude-code
15	  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-claude-code'
16	  config:
17	    provider: claude-code    # required; the route registered on ctx.llm
18	    displayName: Claude Code # optional; the route name when omitted
19	    models:                  # required; a request naming any other model fails with UNKNOWN_MODEL
20	      - id: default          # the id harness requests select
21	        name: Claude Code default
22	        contextWindow: 200000 # optional; what the token meter and compaction threshold read
23	      # productModel names what the installation is asked to run; omit it and
24	      # the installation runs whatever it is configured to run.
25	      - id: fast
26	        productModel: <a model id this installation accepts>
27	    env:                     # optional; explicit entries over the scrubbed parent environment
28	      CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_CLIENT_APP: deepseek-harness/1
29	    effort: high             # optional; low | medium | high | xhigh | max
30	    thinking:                # optional; adaptive | enabled (with budgetTokens) | disabled
31	      type: adaptive
32	    queryTimeoutMs: 300000   # optional; maximum idle interval between messages of one query
33	    disposeGraceMs: 3000     # optional; CLI process-tree termination grace
34	    retryPolicy:             # optional; omission uses bounded normal defaults
35	      mode: normal
36	```
37	
38	`provider` is required and has no default: the route name is the composition's statement of which seam key this installation answers on, and two installations configured side by side must be able to name themselves differently.
39	
40	`models` is required and has no default either. The harness cannot interrogate an installation for the models its subscription entitles, so the catalog is operator configuration. `ctx.llm.listModels(provider)` returns these entries, `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo(provider, id)` returns the exact entry with its `contextWindow`, and — unlike the keyed adapters, whose catalogs are advisory — a request naming an unlisted model fails with `LlmError('UNKNOWN_MODEL')` before any query starts. Each entry declares `inputModalities: ['text']`, so image content is refused as a declared negative capability. An entry's optional `productModel` is passed to the installation as the product's `model` option; omitting it leaves that option off, which is the configuration a deployment wants when the installation's own default is the intended model.
41

1	# @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-claude-code
2	
3	[English](README.md) | 中文
4	
5	用运维方已完成认证的 Claude Code 安装来提供 harness 的 LLM 缝（seam），于是没有 API key 的主机同样可以让每一种 harness 角色——implementer agent、validator、judge、program department、workflow worker、进程内 subagent——跑在该订阅上。
6	
7	该路由上每一次 `generate()` 都是通过官方 Agent SDK 向该安装发起的一次无状态查询（query）。harness 的 system prompt 成为查询的 system prompt，会话与 harness 工具定义成为查询的 prompt 文本，答案则以结构化输出（structured output）返回，由本包解析为缝的 `StreamChunk` 协议。产品自身不执行任何工具、也不读取工作区，因此每一次工具调用都回到 harness 的 agent loop，在 harness 自己的工具、会话日志、读取屏障（read barrier）、预算策略与审批下执行。
8	
9	包根导出 Cordis 插件契约、`ClaudeCodeAdapter` 以及二者使用的请求/响应辅助函数；SDK 是本包的运行时依赖，而不是缝的依赖。
10	
11	## 配置
12	
13	```yaml
14	- id: llm-claude-code
15	  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-claude-code'
16	  config:
17	    provider: claude-code    # required; the route registered on ctx.llm
18	    displayName: Claude Code # optional; the route name when omitted
19	    models:                  # required; a request naming any other model fails with UNKNOWN_MODEL
20	      - id: default          # the id harness requests select
21	        name: Claude Code default
22	        contextWindow: 200000 # optional; what the token meter and compaction threshold read
23	      # productModel names what the installation is asked to run; omit it and
24	      # the installation runs whatever it is configured to run.
25	      - id: fast
26	        productModel: <a model id this installation accepts>
27	    env:                     # optional; explicit entries over the scrubbed parent environment
28	      CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_CLIENT_APP: deepseek-harness/1
29	    effort: high             # optional; low | medium | high | xhigh | max
30	    thinking:                # optional; adaptive | enabled (with budgetTokens) | disabled
31	      type: adaptive
32	    queryTimeoutMs: 300000   # optional; maximum idle interval between messages of one query
33	    disposeGraceMs: 3000     # optional; CLI process-tree termination grace
34	    retryPolicy:             # optional; omission uses bounded normal defaults
35	      mode: normal
36	```
37	
38	`provider` 必填且没有默认值：路由名是组合对“该安装在哪个缝键上作答”的声明，两个并列配置的安装必须能够各自命名。
39	
40	`models` 同样必填且没有默认值。harness 无法向安装查询其订阅所授权的模型，因此目录属于运维方配置。`ctx.llm.listModels(provider)` 返回这些条目，`ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo(provider, id)` 返回带 `contextWindow` 的精确条目；与目录仅供参考的带密钥适配器不同，请求指定未登记的模型会在任何查询开始之前以 `LlmError('UNKNOWN_MODEL')` 失败。每个条目声明 `inputModalities: ['text']`，因此图像内容作为已声明的负向能力被拒绝。条目可选的 `productModel` 作为产品的 `model` 选项传给安装；省略它就不下发该选项，这正是希望由安装自身默认模型作答的部署所需的配置。
41	
42	`effort` 与 `thinking` 对该路由上的每个请求原样传入查询。它们是路由级而非请求级的，因为该路由不发布任何推理档位：设置 `GenerateOptions.reasoningEffort` 的请求会在缝处以 `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT` 失败。
43	
44	`queryTimeoutMs` 限定的是一次查询中消息之间的间隔，而不是答案本身的时长。查询要求下发部分助手事件，这些事件在安装仍在工作时到达，因此看门狗在进展证据上重新计时，只有在安装静默时才到期。到期抛出 `LlmError('TIMEOUT')`；更早的调用方中止抛出 `ABORTED`。
45	
46	## 一次请求如何渲染
47	
48	渲染是缝所交付请求的纯函数，而该请求本身派生自会话日志，因此本包发送的一切都可由日志重建。进入查询的有两样东西：
49	
50	- **system prompt。** `GenerateOptions.system` 成为查询的自定义 system prompt，取代产品自身的预设而非追加其后。没有 system prompt 的请求发送一个空串，同样取代该预设。
51	- **prompt 文本。** 先是一行阅读指引，请求带工具时接上工具区，然后是按日志顺序的整段会话。每个元素都由 `dsh-` 前缀的标签框定：`<dsh-user>`、带每次请求调用嵌套 `<dsh-tool-call id name>` 的 `<dsh-assistant>`、每条结果一个 `<dsh-tool-result id status>`，以及会话内部出现的 system 消息所用的 `<dsh-system>`。属性值会转义；当任何被渲染内容自身含有该前缀时，整次渲染改用第一个空闲的编号前缀（`dsh2-`、`dsh3-`……），因此没有任何消息会被读成框架。
52	
53	查询请求的结构化输出为 `{ content: string, toolCalls: [{ name, arguments }] }`，其中 `arguments` 是该调用的 JSON 对象编码成的 JSON 字符串——正是缝端到端携带的形式。内置工具、MCP 服务器、文件系统设置与会话持久化全部关闭（`tools: []`、`mcpServers: {}`、`strictMcpConfig: true`、`settingSources: []`、`persistSession: false`），权限模式从不提问且拒绝未预先批准的一切。harness 的取消信号驱动 SDK 的 abort controller，SDK 拉起的 CLI 交由 `ctx.subprocess` 接管，由它拥有该进程树与终止阶梯。
54	
55	查询的轮次上限是两条助手消息。不提供任何工具，才是“一次 `generate()` 等于一次模型响应”的保证；上限取二而非一，是因为产品交付结构化输出本身要花掉一条助手消息，所以在此之前还说了话的回复需要两条。
56	
57	## 返回什么
58	
59	`structured_output` 变为 chunk 流：可见文本非空时作为一个 text 块，随后每个返回的调用一个 tool-call 块，然后是用量，最后是 finish（答案请求了调用则为 `tool-calls`，否则为 `stop`）。调用 id 按响应铸造为 `<result uuid>-<序号>`，因此在会话内唯一，并对回应它的工具结果保持稳定。token 计数直接映射——产品本就把未缓存输入与缓存读写分开上报，这正是缝自身的不相交约定。
60	
61	结构化输出缺失或不可读属于 provider 失败，绝不是空答案：`MALFORMED_RESPONSE`。既无文本又无工具调用的答案是 `EMPTY_RESPONSE`，默认重试策略会重试它。
62	
63	## 错误
64	
65	目录未声明的模型为 `UNKNOWN_MODEL`，图像内容为 `UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`，二者都发生在任何查询之前。主机在 subprocess 缝的 PATH 上没有 `claude` 时为 `MISSING_EXECUTABLE`。空闲到期与调用方取消分别为 `TIMEOUT` 与 `ABORTED`。答案不可用为 `MALFORMED_RESPONSE` 与 `EMPTY_RESPONSE`，查询结束却未发布结果为 `STREAM_CLOSED`。失败的产品结果依据它携带的全部 code、terminal reason、stop reason 与消息分类：先经缝的共享分类器给出 `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` 与 `QUOTA`，再按结果子类型给出 `MAX_TURNS`、`QUOTA`、`MALFORMED_RESPONSE` 或 `PRODUCT_ERROR`。SDK 以抛出而非发布结果的方式报告的失败成为 `TRANSPORT`，其消息中带有渲染后的 cause 链。
66	
67	## Model Experience
68	
69	### 查询 prompt
70	
71	#### What the model sees
72	
73	该安装的模型把 harness 的 system prompt 原样读作自己的 system prompt——外面套着产品自己的一层外壳，本包既不撰写也无法查看它，这是此处唯一一项会话日志无法重建的模型可见输入——然后读到携带阅读指引、工具区与会话的 prompt 文本。下面的具名占位符代表请求自身的数据：`{ns}` 是标签前缀（内容未与之冲突时为 `dsh`），`{tool name}`、`{tool description}` 与 `{tool schema}` 来自 `GenerateOptions.tools`，消息文本、调用 id 与参数来自会话。
74	
75	##### 指引与工具区原文
76	
77	```markdown
78	Answer the last turn of the conversation below. Elements tagged `<{ns}-…>` are the harness's framing; everything between them is the conversation.
79	<{ns}-tools>
80	The harness runs these tools, not you. Ask for a call by putting it in `toolCalls`; its result arrives in the next request.
81	<{ns}-tool name="{tool name}">
82	{tool description}
83	Arguments (JSON Schema):
84	{tool schema}
85	</{ns}-tool>
86	</{ns}-tools>
87	```
88	
89	#### Token effect
90	
91	会话与工具定义在每次请求时重新渲染，因此输入随历史增长的方式与带密钥路由完全一致，另加固定的框架标签与两句指引。结构化输出 schema 与产品自身的外壳还会增加一部分本包不度量的固定开销。
92	
93	#### KV Cache effect
94	
95	每次查询彼此独立：只向安装请求一次无状态作答且不持久化会话，因此该路由发送的内容不会跨轮复用前缀。产品上报的缓存读写会透传到缝的用量中，但本包不就它们由哪段前缀产生作任何断言。
96	
97	### 结构化答案
98	
99	#### What the model sees
100	
101	本包不添加任何内容。解析出的文本与工具调用成为 agent loop 记录并组装的 harness 内容块，harness 产出的工具结果在下一次请求的会话中返回。
102	
103	#### Token effect
104	
105	生成的 token 遵循该路由所配置的 effort 与 thinking 策略；只有 loop 保留的块会影响后续输入。
106	
107	#### KV Cache effect
108	
109	保留的响应块追加到下一次请求所渲染的会话中。由于每次查询都是无状态的，这种增长改变的是下一个 prompt，而不是延长某个可复用前缀。
110	
111	## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
112	
113	- **跨轮没有 prompt 缓存** —— 一次 `generate()` 就是一次无状态查询，因此整段会话每轮都重新发送、重新读取。带密钥路由本可主要由缓存服务的会话，在这里要付全额输入，而每轮时延是产品自身的启动加作答时间。
114	- **产品的 system prompt 外壳无法由会话日志重建** —— system prompt 由 harness 撰写，但安装会用本包既不写入也看不到的文本将其包裹，因此 `request/header` 记录了除该外壳之外的一切。
115	- **`maxTokens`、`temperature`、`topP`、`seed` 与 `stop` 被丢弃** —— 产品的查询选项没有对应项，而缝的契约是：线路上没有对应字段的适配器丢弃该字段。
116	- **不发布任何推理档位** —— `effort` 与 `thinking` 是路由级配置，因此 `agent/request` 无法像在带密钥路由上那样逐步改变推理档位。

45	
46	## 一次请求如何渲染
47	
48	渲染是缝所交付请求的纯函数，而该请求本身派生自会话日志，因此本包发送的一切都可由日志重建。进入查询的有两样东西：
49	
50	- **system prompt。** `GenerateOptions.system` 成为查询的自定义 system prompt，取代产品自身的预设而非追加其后。没有 system prompt 的请求发送一个空串，同样取代该预设。
51	- **prompt 文本。** 先是一行阅读指引，请求带工具时接上工具区，然后是按日志顺序的整段会话。每个元素都由 `dsh-` 前缀的标签框定：`<dsh-user>`、带每次请求调用嵌套 `<dsh-tool-call id name>` 的 `<dsh-assistant>`、每条结果一个 `<dsh-tool-result id status>`，以及会话内部出现的 system 消息所用的 `<dsh-system>`。属性值会转义；当任何被渲染内容自身含有该前缀时，整次渲染改用第一个空闲的编号前缀（`dsh2-`、`dsh3-`……），因此没有任何消息会被读成框架。
52	
53	查询请求的结构化输出为 `{ content: string, toolCalls: [{ name, arguments }] }`，其中 `arguments` 是该调用的 JSON 对象编码成的 JSON 字符串——正是缝端到端携带的形式。内置工具、MCP 服务器、文件系统设置与会话持久化全部关闭（`tools: []`、`mcpServers: {}`、`strictMcpConfig: true`、`settingSources: []`、`persistSession: false`），权限模式从不提问且拒绝未预先批准的一切。harness 的取消信号驱动 SDK 的 abort controller，SDK 拉起的 CLI 交由 `ctx.subprocess` 接管，由它拥有该进程树与终止阶梯。

55	查询的轮次上限是两条助手消息。不提供任何工具，才是“一次 `generate()` 等于一次模型响应”的保证；上限取二而非一，是因为产品交付结构化输出本身要花掉一条助手消息，所以在此之前还说了话的回复需要两条。
56	
57	## 返回什么
58	
59	`structured_output` 变为 chunk 流：可见文本非空时作为一个 text 块，随后每个返回的调用一个 tool-call 块，然后是用量，最后是 finish（答案请求了调用则为 `tool-calls`，否则为 `stop`）。调用 id 按响应铸造为 `<result uuid>-<序号>`，因此在会话内唯一，并对回应它的工具结果保持稳定。token 计数直接映射——产品本就把未缓存输入与缓存读写分开上报，这正是缝自身的不相交约定。
60	
61	结构化输出缺失或不可读属于 provider 失败，绝不是空答案：`MALFORMED_RESPONSE`。既无文本又无工具调用的答案是 `EMPTY_RESPONSE`，默认重试策略会重试它。
62	
63	## 错误
64	
65	目录未声明的模型为 `UNKNOWN_MODEL`，图像内容为 `UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`，二者都发生在任何查询之前。主机在 subprocess 缝的 PATH 上没有 `claude` 时为 `MISSING_EXECUTABLE`。空闲到期与调用方取消分别为 `TIMEOUT` 与 `ABORTED`。答案不可用为 `MALFORMED_RESPONSE` 与 `EMPTY_RESPONSE`，查询结束却未发布结果为 `STREAM_CLOSED`。失败的产品结果依据它携带的全部 code、terminal reason、stop reason 与消息分类：先经缝的共享分类器给出 `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` 与 `QUOTA`，再按结果子类型给出 `MAX_TURNS`、`QUOTA`、`MALFORMED_RESPONSE` 或 `PRODUCT_ERROR`。SDK 以抛出而非发布结果的方式报告的失败成为 `TRANSPORT`，其消息中带有渲染后的 cause 链。
66	
67	## Model Experience
68	
69	### 查询 prompt
70	
71	#### What the model sees
72	
73	该安装的模型把 harness 的 system prompt 原样读作自己的 system prompt——外面套着产品自己的一层外壳，本包既不撰写也无法查看它，这是此处唯一一项会话日志无法重建的模型可见输入——然后读到携带阅读指引、工具区与会话的 prompt 文本。下面的具名占位符代表请求自身的数据：`{ns}` 是标签前缀（内容未与之冲突时为 `dsh`），`{tool name}`、`{tool description}` 与 `{tool schema}` 来自 `GenerateOptions.tools`，消息文本、调用 id 与参数来自会话。
74	
75	##### 指引与工具区原文
76	
77	```markdown
78	Answer the last turn of the conversation below. Elements tagged `<{ns}-…>` are the harness's framing; everything between them is the conversation.
79	<{ns}-tools>
80	The harness runs these tools, not you. Ask for a call by putting it in `toolCalls`; its result arrives in the next request.
81	<{ns}-tool name="{tool name}">
82	{tool description}
83	Arguments (JSON Schema):
84	{tool schema}
85	</{ns}-tool>
86	</{ns}-tools>
87	```
88	
89	#### Token effect
90	
91	会话与工具定义在每次请求时重新渲染，因此输入随历史增长的方式与带密钥路由完全一致，另加固定的框架标签与两句指引。结构化输出 schema 与产品自身的外壳还会增加一部分本包不度量的固定开销。
92	
93	#### KV Cache effect
94	
95	每次查询彼此独立：只向安装请求一次无状态作答且不持久化会话，因此该路由发送的内容不会跨轮复用前缀。产品上报的缓存读写会透传到缝的用量中，但本包不就它们由哪段前缀产生作任何断言。
96	
97	### 结构化答案
98	
99	#### What the model sees
100	
101	本包不添加任何内容。解析出的文本与工具调用成为 agent loop 记录并组装的 harness 内容块，harness 产出的工具结果在下一次请求的会话中返回。
102	
103	#### Token effect
104	
105	生成的 token 遵循该路由所配置的 effort 与 thinking 策略；只有 loop 保留的块会影响后续输入。
106	
107	#### KV Cache effect
108	
109	保留的响应块追加到下一次请求所渲染的会话中。由于每次查询都是无状态的，这种增长改变的是下一个 prompt，而不是延长某个可复用前缀。
110	
111	## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
112	
113	- **跨轮没有 prompt 缓存** —— 一次 `generate()` 就是一次无状态查询，因此整段会话每轮都重新发送、重新读取。带密钥路由本可主要由缓存服务的会话，在这里要付全额输入，而每轮时延是产品自身的启动加作答时间。
114	- **产品的 system prompt 外壳无法由会话日志重建** —— system prompt 由 harness 撰写，但安装会用本包既不写入也看不到的文本将其包裹，因此 `request/header` 记录了除该外壳之外的一切。
115	- **`maxTokens`、`temperature`、`topP`、`seed` 与 `stop` 被丢弃** —— 产品的查询选项没有对应项，而缝的契约是：线路上没有对应字段的适配器丢弃该字段。
116	- **不发布任何推理档位** —— `effort` 与 `thinking` 是路由级配置，因此 `agent/request` 无法像在带密钥路由上那样逐步改变推理档位。
117	- **产品侧的结构化输出重试会超出轮次上限** —— 上限是两条助手消息，恰好覆盖一次作答及其交付；重试表现为一次失败的查询，由 harness 作为整个请求重试。
118	- **没有 settings 缝热更新** —— 路由事实在加载时解析一次，不同于按请求重读 `ctx.settings` 区块的带密钥适配器。补上它需要一个 settings 命名空间以及带密钥适配器所用的原子路由替换。

All gates pass and the tree is clean.

## Report

**Commit** `a16a12fd6f1aef6af53a0e9c2b3cf94f5fe400c2` on branch `worktree-agent-aef6f2f2d92c48bdc` (worktree fast-forwarded to `692dcf502` first).

### Plugin, config, and route

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-claude-code` at `/home/user/deepseek-harness/.claude/worktrees/agent-aef6f2f2d92c48bdc/packages/llm/llm-claude-code`, `name: 'llm-claude-code'`, `inject: ['llm', 'subprocess']`, registering one adapter via `ctx.llm.registerAdapter([options.provider], adapter)`.

`Config` (`src/config.ts`): `provider` (required, no default — the composition states `claude-code`), `displayName?`, `models` (required, no default; entries `{ id, productModel?, name?, description?, contextWindow? }`), `env?`, `effort?` (`low|medium|high|xhigh|max`), `thinking?` (`{type:'adaptive'} | {type:'enabled',budgetTokens} | {type:'disabled'}`), `queryTimeoutMs?` (default 300 000), `disposeGraceMs?` (default 3 000), `retryPolicy?`. `resolveAdapterOptions` is the one explicit resolve step and re-judges every bound, so a bad composition fails at load.

The catalog is authoritative rather than advisory: `resolveModel` rejects an unlisted id with `UNKNOWN_MODEL` before any query, and every entry declares `inputModalities: ['text']`. `productModel` is the only model identifier anywhere, and it is absent from all fixtures, code, and docs.

### Rendering and mapping back

`src/render.ts` (pure): `GenerateOptions.system` → the query's custom `systemPrompt` (`''` when absent); the tools and conversation → one prompt text — a guide line, a `<dsh-tools>` section (name, description, `Arguments (JSON Schema):`, schema), then `<dsh-conversation>` with `<dsh-user>`, `<dsh-assistant>` + nested `<dsh-tool-call id name>`, `<dsh-tool-result id status>`, `<dsh-system>`, in log order. Attribute values are escaped, and if any rendered content contains the prefix the whole rendering moves to `dsh2-`, `dsh3-`, … so no message can be read as framing.

Query options: `outputFormat: {type:'json_schema'}` for `{content: string, toolCalls: [{name, arguments}]}` (`arguments` a JSON string, matching the seam's raw-JSON contract), `tools: []`, `allowedTools: []`, `disallowedTools: ['AskUserQuestion']`, `mcpServers: {}`, `strictMcpConfig: true`, `settingSources: []`, `persistSession: false`, `permissionMode: 'dontAsk'`, harness signal → `abortController`, CLI resolved and spawned through `ctx.subprocess` with the same `claudeSpawnSpec`/`ManagedClaudeCodeProcess` projection the subagent provider uses.

`src/response.ts`: `structured_output` → text block (when non-empty) + one tool-call block per call with ids `<result uuid>-<index>` → `usage` → `finish` (`tool-calls`/`stop`); usage maps 1:1 (already disjoint); failures classify through `isContextWindowExceededError`/`isQuotaExceededError` then by subtype into `MAX_TURNS`/`QUOTA`/`MALFORMED_RESPONSE`/`PRODUCT_ERROR`. Missing/malformed output is `MALFORMED_RESPONSE`, never an empty answer; nothing at all is `EMPTY_RESPONSE`.

### Keeping the stream alive

`streamIdleTimeoutMs` turned out to be provider-owned (each adapter's own `idleWatchdog` over its upstream), not a seam mechanism. So `queryTimeoutMs` arms an `idleWatchdog` over the SDK message stream, and `includePartialMessages: true` makes `stream_event` partials rearm it, bounding a silent installation rather than the answer's duration.

### Deviations

1. **`maxTurns` is 2, not 1.** With 1 the real run failed every attempt: `Reached maximum number of turns (1)` — the product's structured-output delivery costs an assistant message of its own, so any reply that says something first needs two. With 2 the same run succeeded. The one-response guarantee comes from `tools: []`, not the bound. Documented in the constant's JSDoc, the README, and the note.
2. **Partials are not forwarded to the seam as chunks.** The `StreamChunk` protocol has no block-neutral heartbeat — `BlockAssembler` opens a partial block for any delta, so an empty text delta would add a spurious empty text block to every tool-call-only response and log one `assistant/chunk` per partial. They feed the provider's own watchdog instead. Recorded in the note ("Keeping the query alive") and the README's limitations.
3. **No keyless snapshot.** The snapshot harness replays recorded provider transcripts; this provider is a local process. Stated in the note's acceptance criteria, as the task allowed.
4. `error instanceof LlmError` and an `abort` idempotence guard were removed as dead branches (per-file 100% coverage).
5. `maxTokens` was dropped from `ClaudeCodeModel` — the product's query options have no output cap, so advertising `defaultMaxTokens` would have logged a value that never reached the model.

### Real headless run

`claude -p "ok"` works here, so I ran it. `hello.txt` was created with `hello` and the transcript shows the harness executing everything:

- Assistant turn 1: text `Creating hello.txt and printing its contents.` + two tool calls — `write {"file_path":"hello.txt","content":"hello\n"}` and `bash {"command":"cat hello.txt"}` (ids `672791f7-…-0` / `-1`).
- Tool results: the write path, then `hello\n`.
- Assistant turn 2: `Created hello.txt in the workspace. Contents:\n\nhello`.
- Result usage: `inputTokens 4, outputTokens 301, cacheReadTokens 9251, cacheWriteTokens 6872`.

# AGENTS.md

DeepSeek Harness is a plugin-based agent harness on vendored Cordis: **everything is a plugin**. Read [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) before changing `packages/`; follow [docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md) for documentation.

## Pre-release stance: foundation over blast radius

**Remove this section at the first tagged release.** With no external consumers, prefer the correct foundation over compatibility shims: rename or repackage freely and update every reference together. Backends reject old on-disk formats. SQLite uses monotonic `SCHEMA_VERSION`; `dsh-session` keeps `SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION` at `0` without a compatibility promise.

## Repository layout

```
vendor/      Vendored Cordis source — manifest + sync procedure in vendor/README.md
packages/    @deepseek-ai/dsh-<pkg> workspaces at packages/<group>/<pkg>/

- **An empty `catch` names what it swallows** and why nothing else can reach it; keep the `try` to one statement.
- Do not comment on facts obvious from code.
- **Prefer symmetry for parallel values**; unexplained asymmetry usually signals a missed extraction.
- **Tests describe behavior, not correctness.** Change obsolete behavior with its tests; explain why in the PR.
- **Non-trivial changes MUST include an Agent Note in the same PR;** only mechanical/local edits are exempt ([scope](.agents/notes/README.md#when-to-write-one)). Archived notes are frozen: never edit or treat them as current authority ([archive policy](.agents/notes/README.md#archiving-and-deletion)).
- **Testing policy** — [docs/testing.md](docs/testing.md). Routine bilingual work follows [docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md); only explicit user invocation may run `dsh-translate-docs`. content.text:
Confirmed: `a16a12fd6`, clean tree, branch `worktree-agent-aef6f2f2d92c48bdc`. Report follows.

## Commit

`a16a12fd6f1aef6af53a0e9c2b3cf94f5fe400c2` on `worktree-agent-aef6f2f2d92c48bdc`, message exactly as specified with both trailer lines. The worktree was fast-forwarded to `692dcf502` and `pnpm install --offline` run before any work.

## The plugin, its config, and its route

New package `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-claude-code` at `/home/user/deepseek-harness/.claude/worktrees/agent-aef6f2f2d92c48bdc/packages/llm/llm-claude-code`. Function plugin, no default export: `name = 'llm-claude-code'`, `inject = ['llm', 'subprocess']`. `apply` resolves the config once and calls `ctx.llm.registerAdapter([options.provider], adapter)` with one `ClaudeCodeAdapter`.

`Config` (in `src/config.ts`, schemastery-validated and re-judged by `resolveAdapterOptions`, the one explicit resolve step):

- `provider` — **required, no default.** The route name is the composition's own statement, so the headless fixture says `provider: claude-code` rather than inheriting a constant.
- `models` — **required, no default.** Entries are `{ id, productModel?, name?, description?, contextWindow? }`. `id` is what harness requests name; `productModel` is what the installation is asked to run and is simply omitted from the SDK options when absent, so the installation runs whatever it is configured to run. That is how no model identifier appears in code, docs, or fixtures.
- `env?` — explicit entries layered over `scrubbedParentEnv()`, same posture as the subagent provider.
- `effort?` (`low|medium|high|xhigh|max`) and `thinking?` (`{type:'adaptive'} | {type:'enabled', budgetTokens} | {type:'disabled'}`) — validated passthrough, route-level.
- `queryTimeoutMs?` (default 300 000) and `disposeGraceMs?` (default 3 000), both bounded by `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`.
- `retryPolicy?` — the seam's shared `RetryPolicySchema`, captured with the registration.

`maxTurns` is not configurable; it lives in `src/adapter.ts` as `MAX_TURNS` with its rationale in JSDoc (see deviations). Misconfiguration fails at load: an empty route name, an empty or duplicated catalog, a non-integer `contextWindow`, an unknown effort, an unschedulable timer, or a bad thinking budget all throw before anything registers.

Unlike the keyed adapters, this catalog is authoritative rather than advisory: `resolveModel` rejects an unlisted id with `LlmError('UNKNOWN_MODEL')`, which the seam calls during `prepareCall`, so the refusal lands before any query. Every entry declares `inputModalities: ['text']`, making image input a declared negative capability, and `resolveModel` publishes no `reasoning`, so a request carrying `reasoningEffort` fails with `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT` at the seam.

## How a harness request is rendered

`src/render.ts` is pure and takes only `GenerateOptions`.

- `GenerateOptions.system` becomes the query's `systemPrompt` as a custom string, replacing the product's preset rather than appending to it. A request with no system prompt sends `''`, which still replaces it.
- The conversation and tool definitions become one prompt text: a reading-guide line, then a `<dsh-tools>` section when the request carries tools (per tool: `<dsh-tool name>`, the description, the literal line `Arguments (JSON Schema):`, the serialized schema), then `<dsh-conversation>` with every message in log order — `<dsh-user>`, `<dsh-assistant>` carrying its text and one nested `<dsh-tool-call id name>` per requested call, `<dsh-tool-result id status>` per result, and `<dsh-system>` for a system message that arrived inside the conversation.
- Attribute values escape `&`, `"`, and `<`. Rendering runs a first pass that records every verbatim string it embedded; if any of them contains `<dsh` or `</dsh`, the whole prompt re-renders under the first free numbered prefix (`dsh2-`, `dsh3-`, …), so no message can be read as framing. It stays a pure function of the request.
- Image content throws `UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT` rather than being silently flattened.

Query options (`claudeQueryOptions`): `outputFormat: { type: 'json_schema', schema: RESPONSE_SCHEMA }` for `{ content: string, toolCalls: [{ name, arguments }] }` where `arguments` is the call's JSON object encoded as a JSON string — the exact form the seam carries end to end, which also avoids a free-form object inside a strict schema; `tools: []`, `allowedTools: []`, `disallowedTools: ['AskUserQuestion']`, `mcpServers: {}`, `strictMcpConfig: true`, `settingSources: []`, `persistSession: false`, `permissionMode: 'dontAsk'` (never prompts, denies anything not pre-approved); `env: { ...scrubbedParentEnv(), ...config.env }`; `pathToClaudeCodeExecutable` from `ctx.subprocess.resolveExecutable('claude', env, signal)`; the harness signal wired to the SDK's `abortController`; and `spawnClaudeCodeProcess` handing the CLI to `ctx.subprocess.spawn` through the same `claudeSpawnSpec` / `ManagedClaudeCodeProcess` projection the subagent provider uses, including its Windows batch shim and environment tombstones. Teardown closes the query, terminates the tree, and awaits `waitForExit` + `done`.

## How the structured output maps back

`src/response.ts`. `parseAnswer` reads `structured_output`: a missing, primitive, array-shaped, or field-incomplete value is `MALFORMED_RESPONSE` — never an empty answer. `arguments` is accepted as the JSON string the schema asks for, or re-serialized if the product passes a JSON object through.

`answerChunks` emits, in protocol order: `block-start`/`text-delta`/`block-end` for the visible text when it is non-empty; then per tool call a `block-start`/`tool-call-delta`/`block-end` triple; then `usage`; then `finish` (`tool-calls` when the answer requested any, `stop` otherwise). Call ids are minted deterministically per response as `<result uuid>-<position>`, unique across the session and stable for the tool result that answers them. An answer with neither text nor tool calls is `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, which the default retry policy retries.

`mapUsage` maps straight across — the product already reports uncached input separately from cache reads and writes, matching the seam's disjoint convention — with each counter floored at a process boundary where a field may be absent.

`resultFailure` joins subtype, terminal reason, stop reason, and every reported error into one detail string, runs the seam's shared `isContextWindowExceededError` / `isQuotaExceededError` classifiers first, then maps by subtype: `error_max_turns` → `MAX_TURNS`, `error_max_budget_usd` → `QUOTA`, `error_max_structured_output_retries` → `MALFORMED_RESPONSE`, `error_during_execution` and a success result the product itself marked failed → `PRODUCT_ERROR`. Other codes: `MISSING_EXECUTABLE` when the host has no `claude`, `TIMEOUT` on idle expiry, `ABORTED` on caller cancellation, `STREAM_CLOSED` for a query that ended without publishing a result, and `TRANSPORT` (carrying the rendered `errorChain`) for a failure the SDK raises by throwing.

## How the stream is kept alive

Reading `packages/llm/llm-retry`, `packages/core/agent-loop`, and both keyed adapters showed that `streamIdleTimeoutMs` is **provider-owned**, not a seam mechanism: each adapter runs its own `idleWatchdog` from `dsh-timeout` over its own upstream, and neither the seam nor the loop imposes a stream deadline.

So this provider does the same: `queryTimeoutMs` arms an `idleWatchdog` over the SDK message stream, fused with the caller's signal, and `includePartialMessages: true` makes the product publish `stream_event` partials while it works. Each partial is an iterator value, so `watchdog.next()` rearms on it. The bound is therefore the gap between messages, not the answer's duration — a silent installation expires as `TIMEOUT`, a thinking one does not. The watchdog's abort drives the SDK's controller, so cancellation and expiry both stop the CLI. A test pins that partials inside the interval keep a query alive that would otherwise time out.

## The real headless run

`claude -p "ok"` answers on this host, so I ran the with-key-style e2e for real (`DSH_E2E_CLAUDE_CODE=1`). It passed, and the manual run of the same composition produced this transcript:

- Assistant turn 1: text `Creating hello.txt and printing its contents.` plus two harness tool calls — `write {"file_path":"hello.txt","content":"hello\n"}` (id `672791f7-…-0`) and `bash {"command":"cat hello.txt"}` (id `…-1`).
- The harness executed both under its own tools: the write result reported the path; the bash result was `hello\n`.
- Assistant turn 2: `Created hello.txt in the workspace. Contents:\n\nhello`.
- Result usage: `inputTokens 4, outputTokens 301, cacheReadTokens 9251, cacheWriteTokens 6872`. `hello.txt` was verified on disk outside the agent.

The product ran no tool of its own; every call came back through the seam.

## Deviations

1. **`MAX_TURNS` is 2, not 1.** With 1 the real run failed all three attempts: the SDK throws `Reached maximum number of turns (1)` because the product's structured-output delivery is itself an assistant message, so any reply that says something before delivering needs two. With 2 the same run succeeded first time. What guarantees one `generate()` is one model response is `tools: []`, not the turn bound — the product cannot act between turns. The constant's JSDoc, the README, and the note all state this; the note's Risks records that a product-side structured-output retry would exceed it.
2. **SDK partials are not forwarded to the seam as chunks**, contrary to "stream partials to the seam". The `StreamChunk` protocol has no block-neutral heartbeat: `BlockAssembler.ensure` opens a partial block for *any* delta, so an empty text delta would add a spurious empty text block to every tool-call-only response and log one `assistant/chunk` per partial — against the repo's own convention (`llm-deepseek`'s translator explicitly refuses to open a block on an empty delta). The partials feed the provider's watchdog instead. The cost, first-token time equal to whole-answer time, is recorded in the note and the README.
3. **No keyless snapshot.** The snapshot harness replays recorded provider transcripts; this provider is a local process whose answers are not recorded, and recording the SDK message stream is a separate slice. Stated in the note's acceptance criteria as the task permitted; `pnpm run test:snapshot -t "llm"` matches nothing.
4. **`maxTokens` dropped from `ClaudeCodeModel`.** The product's query options carry no output cap, so publishing `defaultMaxTokens` would have logged a materialized value that never reached the model. The README's limitations list `maxTokens`, `temperature`, `topP`, `seed`, and `stop` as dropped, per the seam's "an adapter whose wire has no equivalent drops it".
5. Two branches were removed as dead rather than left uncovered: an `instanceof LlmError` re-throw in the failure classifier (nothing inside the guarded region raises one) and an already-aborted guard before `controller.abort` (abort is idempotent).
6. `knip.json` gained an entry/project block for the package (its `*.e2e.ts` files are otherwise reported unused), matching the sibling llm packages.

## Things worth flagging

- Three generated docs moved for reasons outside my slice: `docs/subsystems/improvement.*` (one source line number), `docs/config-catalog.*` and `docs/module-graph.*` (that line number plus an `environment-runner --> subagent` edge). Those catalogs were already stale on the base commit from another agent's change to `packages/improvement/environment-runner`, and `doc-sync` cannot pass without regenerating them. I mirrored the Chinese twins by hand and re-recorded the pairing. No source under `packages/subagent/**`, `packages/mcp/**`, `packages/improvement/**`, or `packages/governance/**` was touched, and `packages/subagent/subagent-claude-code/tests/real-product.spec.ts` was never run.
- The custom-spawn projection (`src/process.ts`) and the teardown helper are a deliberate, `jscpd:ignore`-marked copy of the subagent provider's, with the reason recorded in both places and in the note: each seam owns the process lifetime of the product it drives, and neither package may depend on the other.
- The empty-system-prompt case (`systemPrompt: ''`) is exercised by unit tests but not by a real query — the headless example always supplies a system prompt. If the SDK were to treat `''` as absent and fall back to its preset, that path would need a probe; I did not spend a real query confirming it.
- Nothing else was left undone. The package README pair, `docs/subsystems/llm-streaming.md` (+ ZH), `packages/llm/README.md` (+ ZH), the proposed Agent Note pair with all required sections, the headless fixture at `examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/llm/llm-claude-code/cordis.yml`, `tsconfig.host.json`, and `examples/package.json` all landed in the same commit.
